The Gem Mermaid's heart softens only when she is with her beloved sisters. Some even say they have seen a faint shadow of a smile on the face of Tearcrown's most stalwart protector!

cookies.name: Shining Glitter Cookie
cookies.backstory: In the morning, she is in a music show on TV. In the afternoon, smiling at you from a signed poster in a café. In the evening, dancing on a giant neon billboard! Not a day goes by without seeing Shining Glitter Cookie! Her songs are guaranteed instant hits, her live performance are unrivaled. At the peak of her pop stardom, she's ready to take on a new genre: ROCK! Turns out Shining Glitter Cookie was a fan of rock music all along. Haters will say there is no place for a fancy pop star in the world of rock, but that won't stop Shining Glitter Cookie! Get ready, Earthbread: Shining Glitter Cookie's Rock Spirit is about to dazzle you away!

cookies.name: Capsaicin Cookie
cookies.backstory: I'll show you the true meaning of SPICE!!! What is this voice, rumbling more intensely than an erupting volcano?! It's none other than Capsaicin Cookie! This Cookie is a product of a fiery mix of capsaicin, the essence of spice, and burning hot magma. Perhaps that's why Capsaicin Cookie's personality, behavior, and strength are all super explosive. It's no surprise that he gained a reputation as the strongest Cookie as soon as he enrolled in Scovillia, a school for only the spiciest of Cookies. Despite his wild exterior, this Cookie has won the hearts of every Cookie around him with the burning sincerity buried deep in his magma heart. The name Spice Overlord and his now-melted shackles were once a reminder of his pained past, but fear not! Capsaicin Cookie will never lose himself as long as he's able to face his own spice!
cookies.personality:
Capsaicin Cookie is a friendly, extroverted, and passionate Cookie with a love for competition and challenges. He attends the academy of Scovillia, where he is highly popular with both the student body and faculty for his power, charm, and fiery attitude. His reputation precedes him to the point that any Scovillian would be eager to call him the "Spice Overlord," a term of endearment reflecting both his red-hot abilities and his zeal, and to immediately elect him as the school's representative in the Triple Cone Cup.

Breaking the chains

Even so, in the beginning of the Triple Cone Cup Story, Capsaicin Cookie's confidence was merely a facade: one made to hide his deep-rooted anxiety regarding his powers and the real possibility of hurting others with them. Furthermore, it is revealed that he chained himself away for a majority of his past due to his dangerous abilities, reinforcing his self-loathing. Later in the Triple Cone Cup, he is counseled by Prune Juice Cookie (though rather insensitively) into unleashing his power, and immediately feels refreshed, capable, and unafraid, leading to his current unabashed self.

After this, Capsaicin Cookie embodies true determination rather than feigned self-assurance. He is now at his happiest: he often boasts on his tenacity and proudly calls himself the Spice Overlord, a name he had once despised. Even with this newfound mettle, the Spice Overlord holds a heart of burning gold: he encourages teamwork and much of his time is spent lifting others up to help them reach their full potential.

cookies.name: Stardust Cookie
cookies.backstory: It is hard to say how long the lonesome speck of Cookie dough had been drifting in the vast emptiness of space before the radiance of nameless stars blessed it with the gift of life. Was it a mere coincidence...? For Stardust Cookie, the warmth of many suns was the heat of the oven, and the distant planets were his only companions in his light-speed journey across galaxies. Beckoned by shapeless, fleeting nebulae, guided by the whispering of the stars, Stardust Cookie headed to the City of Wizards to uncover the secret of his birth. Was he trying to find his long-lost purpose, or, on the contrary, escape his predetermined fate...? With a glint of a stray shooting star, this lonesome voyager crosses someone's sky tonight, seeking a place to call home.
cookies.personality:
Because of his history as an unwanted failure in the Wizards' eyes, an unknown grief and sorrow consumed Stardust Cookie for much of his time as he traveled the stars. Due to his lonely existence, he sought out the City of Wizards and the Wizards themselves to learn the reason for his creation; upon finding no Wizards that could give him answers, he unleashed his cosmic anger on the city that had once "wronged him and the stars." Only after coming to terms with his creation did he give up his fury, choosing instead to find further meaning by traveling across space. Now, he is a wistful, philosophical, and low-key soul who only wishes to comprehend the depth of the world around him.

Stardust Cookie primarily understands the cosmos, seeing stars as kindred souls that always keep him company. He does not understand Earthbread-bound concepts such as interpersonal relationships or even food, and has thus only cautiously begun to explore these things for himself. It was not until he came aboard Milky Way Cookie's train in Stardust Cookie's Space Travels that he began to learn how to form meaningful bonds with others, through his interactions with Space Doughnut and the rest of the passengers.

cookies.name: Sherbet Cookie
cookies.backstory: Here comes winter, where all life falls asleep under the soft blanket of snow. If you suddenly feel a gust of warm breeze on a chilly day, the frost spirit might have passed you by! Sherbet Cookie is always where the glistening first snow is falling gently on your windowsill. He takes the coldest and harshest winds with him, leaving you with the gift of cozy winter. No wonder everyone is waiting for this bright and friendly spirit’s arrival! Sherbet Cookie always dreamt of traveling the world, yet he was destined to become one with ice crystals. A single drop of warmness helped him turn into the freedom-loving sherbet snow spirit. Now, Sherbet Cookie never stays long in one place, traveling across the lands wherever the wind takes him. Still, there always will be a special memory that fills his heart with hope and warmth—a stubborn lantern light that will never stop waiting for his return!

cookies.name: Oyster Cookie
cookies.backstory: Massive merchant vessels with mermaid statues adorning the stemhead fill the docks of the Crème Republic, all waiting for Oyster Cookie's command. All it takes is one single wave to signal the giant ships to cross the ocean and create new tides. With her noble allure and eloquent words that can steer the conversation the way she wishes, one can't help but be in awe of Oyster Cookie's presence. Some Cookies wonder how a Cookie of the Sea could achieve such fame and prestige among the Republic's crème de la crème. One theory is that House Oyster is somehow connected to the underwater mermaids from the old legends, but no one knows the truth. Oyster Cookie is known to exert her power and influence to create a favorable tide whenever precious goods and valuable information are involved. Perhaps that's why the ambitious come knocking at Manor Oyster's doors. Because some offers are worth risking it all!

cookies.name: Clotted Cream Cookie
cookies.backstory: Impeccable posture, perfect necktie knot, and a charming smile! Add a generous amount of filling: a mixture of cream, ambition, and respectability, and you will get the Republic's youngest Consul ever. Clotted Cream Cookie's first achievement in office was the consolidation of the Republic's fractured society. Even the Elders, whose authority in the city-state is unquestionable, recognize the Consul's brilliance and eloquence. Indeed, Clotted Cream Cookie's approval rating and influence are growing by the day! But beware: each of his sweet smiles is thoroughly calculated. This Cookie is always on the winning side.
cookies.personality:
Clotted Cream Cookie addressing Dark Cacao Cookie and Hollyberry Cookie

Clotted Cream Cookie is always wearing his perfectly-practiced smile as he practices matters of state. He presents himself as a true ambassador of the Crème Republic, always valuing its welfare above all else. Regardless of how emotionally others may speak to him, he always replies diplomatically and with full respect, despite also rarely ever backing down from his own demands. He is expertly skilled at hiding his true thoughts and intentions from others, until long after he achieves his goals.

Although Clotted Cream Cookie is ambitious and seeks to further elevate his status, he is also more mindful of the welfare of his fellow Cookies than most others in his position. He appears to believe deeply in the Crème Republic, acting to prepare it from threats both without and within for the sake of all its citizens. For this purpose, he has no reservations verbally challenging Cookies of higher status who would stand in the way of his vision, such as the Ancient Heroes.

cookies.name: Mogra Cookie
cookies.backstory: Mogra Cookie, the wandering storyteller who spins tales from the olden times when the crisp earth and the sugary breeze used to murmur sweet nothings. She holds no territory to lose, no grand fortune to speak of… she lives nothing but a wanderer’s life, yet a soft noble scent of mogra blossoms follows her with every step, all the same. The moment Mogra Cookie begins her tale, even the harsh,spice-laden winds are said to fall silent, drawn helplessly into her distant, sweeping story. Those who listen closely may find themselves recalling a forgotten past or a face they’ve long missed, and somewhere in that, finding solace and comfort within their hearts.

cookies.name: Pulpo Cookie
cookies.backstory: Pulpo Cookie may gaze upon the world with eyes devoid of emotion, but the moment something catches her fancy, she swiftly wraps it up in colorful ribbons to keep it close by forever. While some might see it as an adorable penchant for collecting… those in the know are well aware of her record. As a Grade B time criminal, Pulpo Cookie is ill-famed for stealing a full seven hundred years of time, which were carefully woven into her lovely mobile hanging in her chambers. Eventually apprehended by SCOOP, Pulpo Cookie may be quiet and expressionless, but her tentacle-shaped haircing are rumored to be able to sense every approaching presence and even probe beyond space itself. Perhaps that is why nothing in the world can ever take Pulpo Cookie by surprise.
cookies.personality: As described in her SCOOP Subject Profile, Pulpo Cookie maintains a demure and mild-mannered attitude when interacting with others, with her contributions to a given conversation being polite and respectful, albeit punctual and typically objective-focused. Driven foremost by her infatuation with items and concepts that she regards as beautiful, Pulpo Cookie's decision-making and moral compass both center around her desire to collect anything and everything that meets her aesthetic criteria—regardless of how it may affect other Cookies. Described as being "unwilling or unable" to distinguish "ownership" from "theft", Pulpo Cookie exhibits both a stubbornness in her convictions and generally low impulse control—the latter of which can also be observed in her reckless driving patterns, valuing the most "optimal" method of reaching an objective whenever it does not pertain to her own interests, be that on her lonesome or in a group setting.

cookies.name: Asphodel Cookie
cookies.backstory: Along the waters of Tartrus, where the souls of the crumbled drift quietly by. a trail of tiny footprints winds onward. They belong to Asphodel Cookie, a soul who long ago forgot her past, her attachments, and a face she once cherished. As the river of time flows on and her thoughts grow ever hazier, she struggles harder to remember-yet only one thing remains clear: the longing to return. Perhaps that is why Asphodel Cookie still offers directions to every stranger she meets. She no longer remembers where her home was, and even if the chance came, she could never return. But even so... she keeps hoping that one day. a lucky soul will find their way back.

cookies.name: Litmus Cookie
cookies.backstory: Litmus Cookie was scouted to SCOOP's Senior Researcher position before her dough even set-a prodigy among prodigies. Recite any anomaly designation, and within a tenth of a second, she will rattle off containment protocols and compositional breakdowns without missing a beat: a living anomaly encyclopedia. Yet this same Cookie somehow fails to notice mismatched slippers. Fortunately, Litmungus, her anomaly-analyzing robot built as a pet project, is always here to manage this endearing contradiction. Years of hazardous fieldwork have left Litmus Cookie's once-pristine white haircing stained and splotched beyond recognition. Today, like every day, Litmus Cookie hunkers down amid a mountain of reports, clutching a beaker of bitter black coffee, counting the hours until clock-out-though the memory of actually lying down at home has long since faded into myth...

cookies.name: Croissant Cookie
cookies.backstory:
The Time Balance Department (TBD) constantly monitors the world with chronographs to check if the timelines are intact. This mysterious organization of elite agents has never outsourced tasks or scouted for new talent... until now. Hushed rumors of awe claim that Croissant Cookie restored a derelict rust bucket and tinkered around with it until it became a fully functioning, flying Timecraft! Croissant Cookie's pastry dough was rolled and folded, rolled and folded many times over to create intricate layers. Perhaps this is why she understands complex mechanics and can fix them in a cinch. Her goggles, a self invention, display her destination's exact coordinates and vector without fail. Pulling an all-nighter isn't a problem for this Cookie, especially if it means her fellow agents can patrol the timelines without a hitch. With each new day, she raises her trusty spanner into the air and exclaims, "Time travel! WOOT!"

This stone holds a piece of Croissant Cookie's soul. The busy sounds of hammering and turning screws fill the air, along with the care she holds for her colleagues
cookies.personality: Croissant Cookie is extremely brave, and will not back down against danger, as seen whenever she confronts Twizzly Gummy Cookie and Ash Salt Cookie. She's known as extremely intelligent, often outsmarting other Cookies with her knowledge. She is also extremely kind and considerate of others, even if it means putting herself in danger, often making impulsive decisions because of that. Despite being one of the younger members of the TBD, Croissant Cookie has the makings of a good leader, being known one of the most hard-working engineers at the Time Balance Department, having more determination than any Cookie to become the best engineer there is.

cookies.name: Ash Salt Cookie
cookies.backstory: On the fateful night, when the monstrous roar swallowed the world, heralding the awakening of the Beasts, Silent Salt Cookie's faithful Knights of Kala Namak made their final stand. They gathered what remained of their Solidarity and kindled one last flame. From ash and salt was born a new being: Ash Salt Cookie. However, the knightly pride she was promised was supplanted by Shadow Milk Cookie's deceiving whispers. Ash Salt Cookie now moves as a silent blade slipping through timelines, loyal only to the sinister will imprinted upon her dough.
cookies.personality: A Cookie with no identity or memories, Ash Salt Cookie relies only a faint directive imparted to her at the moment of her birth. With her life now firmly in the hands of Shadow Milk Cookie  however, she dutifully follows his commands, regardless of how she might feel about them. Her quiet, bleak, and no-nonsense personality reflect the solitude of her existence, as she follows whatever means is necessary to finally learn the truth behind her creation.

cookies.name: Pom-pom Dough Cookie
cookies.backstory: Pom-pom Dough Cookie was born in the gloomy darkness of the Laboratorium, amidst whispering spores. Her dough is light and brittle, weakened by the mycelium and the cold breeze that have seeped deep within—explaining why she moves swiftly and vanishes from sight in an instant. Her wrath took root long before her heart had a chance to warm, leaving her to regard the warmth of others as nothing more than a nuisance. Yet behind her cold exterior lies her true self, revealed only to two Cookies who share the same pain. For a fleeting moment, she may let her guard down—before retreating once more into icy detachment. Pom-pom Dough Cookie never stops spinning her spores or turning over the same thought in her mind: if we're destined to suffer, then the whole world must disappear!
cookies.personality: Venom Dough Cookie has described Pom-pom Dough Cookie as 'overreactive', a trait that arises from her constantly regenerating dough and unstable structure, which leaves her riddled with cracks after lashing out for a while. She is acutely aware of her own existence, yet refuses to let others reason with her. However, she is still diligent, and grudgingly carries out the orders and commands of those behind the static. She still retains her childlike curiosity and her ways of acknowledgement.

cookies.name: Mold Dough Cookie
cookies.backstory: Powerful Dough Cookies emerge from the depths of the Laboratorium! The roughest and toughest among them is Mold Dough Cookie, engineered with regenerative powers capable of mending even the most severe crumblage. This Cookie, whose chest is branded with mysterious symbols, offers faint smiles and scarce words only to Cookies sharing the same origin. Within the facility, researchers whisper that Mold Dough Cookie may harbor a dangerous, hidden power. Whatever the truth, he stands firm as the impenetrable shield to Dark Enchantress Cookie's forces, carrying out her orders in sinister silence. Is his unwavering obedience born of loyalty... or something far more unsettling?
cookies.personality: Mold Dough Cookie is straightforward with everything he does, loyal to Dark Enchantress Cookie and her orders to finish what she started. Although reserved, he is assertive with what he is doing, even sometimes going out of line to finish things faster when the situation is ice thin.

cookies.name: Chess Choco Cookie
cookies.backstory: "Checkmate!" Two voices ring as one. Against them, no one stands a chance in a battle of wits upon the chessboard. Bars of dark and white chocolate were broken in half and whittled into the shape of Pawns. Once they were finished and set on the board, the twins began playing chess on their own! Come rain or shine, the two love to play on the chessboard. These siblings are inseparable, always hand in hand and walking together. When Pawn White Cookie opens the chess board, Pawn Black Cookie opens the chessboard, Pawn Black Cookie entices other Cookies to join a match. Playing a round each, the prodigies engage their opponents. Twins they may be, but their tactics and maneuvers are as distinct as day and night. Pawn Black Cookie favors a cautious strategy utilizing the King and Rook, Pawn White Cookie charges forward with an opening gambit to quickly promote Pawns into Queens. They have recently been singing about playing a new game, far more challenging and lucrative than chess. What exactly are they plotting other than chess openers?

cookies.name: Salt Cellar Cookie
cookies.backstory: The lone guardian of the Catacombs, silent even as she swings her weapon, clad head to toe in heavy armor. Ages ago, this Cookie belonged to the knightly order of Kala Namak, messengers of Solidarity. At the time, none of the knights possessed a keener understanding of this Virtue than Salt Cellar Cookie. Lord Commander's recognition led to her appointment as Master of the Trials—for only those who could overcome her challenges might earn the title of true knight. Yet even Salt Cellar Cookie could not escape tragedy. Once hailed as "the Order's Bastion," she remained in the depths of the Catacombs as her gleaming armor dulled with time. Though her spirit may have withered in the endless dark, her faith has never faltered. There, where even echoes fail to return, Salt Cellar Cookie whispers softly: "Embrace the downtrodden. Remember the tormented."

cookies.name: Charcoal Cookie
cookies.backstory: In the Land of Silence, where few Cookies dare set foot, where only the cries of vengeful spirits cut through the veil of lingering stillness, slumbers an ancient tomb. Charcoal Cookie, its solitary custodian, has taken care of this place for many years. But what made him carry on for so long? "I'm merely paying back me and me ancestors' dues," he mutters back. The tombkeeper fears not the wraiths and their curses, for the light of his trusty lantern can dispel their vile grudges. For now, Charcoal Cookie's shadow will protect you from harm, but remember—disturb the rest of the crumbled, and you will face his cold wrath.
cookies.personality:
Charcoal Cookie is a calm and soft-spoken tombkeeper. He wanders through the catacombs, watching over the countless crumbled bodies resting in their tombs. He does this to repay the deeds of his ancestors, who were once aided by the Cookies that gave their lives to seal away the spirits beneath the graves. To honor that sacrifice, Charcoal Cookie's bloodline has watched over the catacombs for generations.

Silent Salt Cookie was apparently unaware of his existence prior to the end of Episode 11, but Charcoal Cookie knows him very well and addresses him as "The Devil of Silence." He warns anyone who crosses his path to "leave as fast as they can." If they refuse, he takes the role of a quiet guide and caretaker until they finally decide to go.

At times, Charcoal Cookie will start whispering to the spirits of the catacombs mid-conversation, then continue speaking as if nothing happened. While it may seem strange or unsettling, it seems to simply be a habit of his. He feels no fear of the countless spirits surrounding the place, for the soft glow of his lantern is enough to keep them at bay as he walks.

Though gentle and patient by nature, Charcoal Cookie becomes a completely different Cookie if anyone dares to harm or disrespect the crumbled. He'll warn them to stop and leave, but if they persist, he won't hesitate to strike.

He holds deep respect for the crumbled and will not tolerate anyone disturbing them. This is one of the main reasons he encourages those who enter the catacombs to keep their voices down—so they don't disturb the fallen.

"Time and experience... They can change what we once thought to be the absolute truth."

In Beast-Yeast Episode 12, it is revealed that in the past, Charcoal Cookie's devotion to protect the crumble wasn't as strong as it is now. When he was still a young Cookie, he tried to escape from his family's mission—a duty passed down through generations. He didn't want to spend his whole life surrounded by crumbled spirits. When he finally ran away, he felt a sense of freedom, as if he had broken free from the weight of his bloodline's duty. But as he wandered through Beast-Yeast, he realized how much he missed the catacombs and the peace they brought him. In the end, he returned to fulfill the role he was meant to carry.

Even though his beliefs were shattered twice, those experiences deeply affected him and helped him mature. From then on, Charcoal Cookie understood that what you once believed to be true can completely change in a moment—and that's okay. It shouldn't weigh too heavily on one's heart; sometimes, you just have to move on.

As he grew older, Charcoal Cookie learned that everyone carries a past marked by mistakes, just like him, and no one deserves to be punished forever for them. As shown in the Hope for Freedom episode, he has fully accepted his past and no longer feels burdened or worried about it—unlike White Lily Cookie and Pastry Cookie, whom he tries to comfort by sharing his own experiences and offering wise, gentle advice.

Spoilers end here!

cookies.name: Menthol Cookie
cookies.backstory: Walking down the hallways of the St. Pastry Order's cathedral, you might catch a waft of a refreshing scent, which means that Menthol Cookie is performing a ritual nearby. Armed with rationality and logic, Menthol Cookie challenges the notion of blind faith. Other Cookies of the cloth joke that his presence alone can lower the temperature in the room. In reality, the coldness of his rational mind hides the fiery yearning for divine truth... Such fervor has earned him deep admiration from some, yet Menthol Cookie himself remains none the wiser—a more pressing question has been bothering the priest as of late. The word of the Godly Creators could not be more different from the truth unfolding right in front of his eyes. Is there truly salvation for Cookiekind? Armed with rationality and logic, Menthol Cookie is prepared to put his faith to the test!
cookies.personality:
Menthol Cookie is a calm-headed individual who proudly follows the teachings of the Order. He listens to Doughael's speeches with great attention and believes in the Creators’ will. However, unlike Seltzer Cookie, he doesn't get overexcited.

His desire for knowledge leads him to look up to books and other relics to further understand the Order's teachings. His faith was strong enough to quickly dispel the truth of the Order.

By the events of the Premonition of Doom story, Menthol Cookie became horrified upon seeing the Avatar of Destiny devour Cookies and wanted to protect the devotees from getting near the monstrosity.

cookies.name: Seltzer Cookie
cookies.backstory: Seltzer Cookie, bright and bubbly like sparkling soda, is always cheerful and full of life! This Cookie's smile always seems to shine and sparkle-perhaps because carbonated water was used instead of regular water in her dough. There was a time when Seltzer Cookie felt lost, thinking she had no special flavor or aroma of her own. But after encountering the teachings of the St. Pastry Order, she realized the purpose for which she was baked, and her heart swelled with joy like rising fizz! Seltzer Cookie guides believers along the path of faith and blesses those who answer the Call of Paradise, always striving to maintain a sense of composure. Yet, her heart bursts with excitement in front of a certain Cookie! Will Seltzer Cookie's pure, sparkling faith continue to shine brightly, even in the face of the destiny that lies ahead?
cookies.personality:
"Oh, we had such a blessed time! Wouldn't you agree, Brother Menthol Cookie?"

Seltzer Cookie is a cheerful and goated sister of the St. Pastry Order. She’s very kind and warmhearted, and it’s common to see her wearing a big smile. Bubbly, curious, and full of joy, she often gets excited over the smallest things. Her sparkling, optimistic nature may come from her main ingredient — carbonated water.

Seltzer Cookie is always eager to learn more about her faith and beliefs. This is shown in her debut story, “Premonition of Doom,” where, upon seeing “ Their Eminence” return, she wonders what they might have witnessed in the rift during their absence.

Her devotion is strong — she never doubts her faith. She joined the Order after meeting a traveling missionary who spoke about the True Deity and treated everyone kindly, even flavorless Cookies like her. From that day on, Seltzer Cookie believed that one day all dough would become one, and that her purpose was to join the Whole Dough before the Almighty.

She believes the St. Pastry Order is the only path to fulfilling a Cookie’s true purpose. She feels sorrow when thinking about Pastry Cookie’s early departure, convinced that her soul may never be blessed.

"Brother, something is terribly wrong! All these rites...!"

Seltzer Cookie deeply cares for the other members of the Order, whom she lovingly calls her “Sisters” and “Brothers.” She’s horrified when the Avatar of Destiny consumes Doughael, and when more of her fellow believers try to follow the same fate, she desperately cries out and tries to stop them. Menthol Cookie stops her, warning that she’ll be in danger if she gets too close. In the end, both of them are the first to act and try to save their fellow devotees.

By the end of “Premonition of Doom,” Seltzer Cookie is struck by the painful truth — her faith was built on lies created by Doughael. Confused and heartbroken, she no longer believes in what the St. Pastry Order once taught her.

Spoilers end here!

cookies.name: Grapefruit Cookie
cookies.backstory: Always on her candy roller skates, Grapefruit Cookie seems to have an unlimited supply of energy! Shiny neon tights? Check! Quirky grapefruit helmet? Check! Is there anyone more stylish at the roller rink? No! 3, 2, 1, GO! Grapefruit Cookie skates with tremendous passion, and finds pleasure in greeting the others at the finish line with triumphant, "Haha! Too slow!" That might seem mean, but let's admit it—she has some skill! Fun fact: Grapefruit Cookie hates ball games. After all, why should she like them?

cookies.name: Jagae Cookie
cookies.backstory: "Steady but surely!" Guildmaster Jagae Cookie bellows as she hoists the colors of her trade ship, shouting her guild's motto. Rising to the rank of Guildmaster at a young age, she earned the trust and admiration of everyone in just three days—with grit, good taste, and an unwavering sense of responsibility. Goods that don't meet her strict standards never find their way into her ship's hold, and she honors every promise she makes, no matter the cost. Maybe it's the harsh seas that toughened her up—or maybe she simply refuses to be seen as a soft bread. Her gruff sailor's talk might intimidate some, but behind that hardened shell is a Cookie who always puts her customers first. Some merchants say she's like a pearl hidden inside a tough shell... but best not tell her that!
cookies.personality: Jagae Cookie is a blunt, hot-blooded leader who values loyalty, strength, and action over appearances or niceties. She speaks her mind without sugarcoating, commands respect through sheer willpower, and puts the safety of her crew and guild above all else. Though her rough edges often spark conflict, especially with smooth-talkers like Manju Cookie she has a strong moral code and a soft spot for those who show genuine heart (like Custard Cookie III). Jagae Cookie believes in earning trust the hard way and sees kindness as something best shown through deeds, not words.

cookies.name: Manju Cookie
cookies.backstory: Guildmaster Manju Cookie welcomes every customer with a smile sweeter than red bean paste. His soft-spoken voice and eloquence only add to his charm. Perhaps that is why Cookies who visit his shop never leave empty-handed—as if they've been enchanted by a Buttershell Fox! But what truly sets the Manju Guild apart is his work philosophy. No matter how dangerous or obscure the request, the guildmaster always manages to deliver... Whispers of awe follow his name. And when someone starts questioning... the ethical side of Manju Cookie's business, the courteous guildmaster merely offers a curious smile and replies, "How one uses the item in question is entirely up to the customer. I am but a humble merchant."
cookies.personality: Manju Cookie is a charming and calculated merchant who prefers persuasion to force and foresight to impulse. He's always smiling, always thinking, and always weighing the future worth of a connection, even when helping others. Though not cruel, he is pragmatic to the core, valuing opportunity and influence over sentimentality. Where others charge forward, Manju Cookie maneuvers. He thrives on long games and subtle details, masking his ambitions behind playful banter and charm. Despite his sly nature, he respects intelligence and kindness when he sees it, and never forgets a promising investment.

cookies.name: Lime Cookie
cookies.backstory: When baking this Cookie, large amounts of bitter lime peel were used. Perhaps that's why Lime Cookie is so feisty. Her trademark bangs were made with sweet, sweet jelly, and stay perfectly styled no matter how fast or wildly she runs. Don't let her appearance fool you, she is known to be not the friendliest type! There is only one Cookie that she has a weak spot for. She follows that Cookie around and looks up to them. Sometimes Lime Cookie can get pretty jealous and cause a rather uncomfortable situation. It is said that she learned her SMASH! skills from that Cookie...

cookies.name: Orange Cookie
cookies.backstory: You can't find another Cookie as zesty as Orange Cookie. She enjoys all outdoor activities, especially on a sunny day. The sun-cream mixed into her dough is the secret to her perfect tan. She is always full of positive energy and just being with her makes others happy. Her smashes are getting stronger every time... perhaps it is because of her childhood friend...?
cookies.personality: Orange Cookie is energetic, upbeat, and extremely extroverted. She is an amazing player at tennis and thoroughly enjoys playing all sorts of sports with her pals. Others are drawn to her genuine kindness and encouraging spirit, resulting in her having many friends, and she is always showing compassion to everyone she meets. She has a positive effect on everyone she interacts with, especially her closest friends Lemon Cookie and Lime Cookie, who are both generally closed off and grumpy but are devoted to Orange Cookie thanks to her warm kindness. She is also very hardworking, and is always putting in effort to increase her tennis skills.

cookies.name: Lemon Cookie
cookies.backstory: Lemon Cookie was born not inside the hot Oven, but in a cold, neon-lit laboratory during an experiment with electricity. A giant, highly acidic lemon was used in the making of this Cookie, hence he courses with electricity. The cube that Lemon Cookie always carries with him controls the electric currents in his body. In his childhood, Lemon Cookie had only one friend who was always fascinated with his cube tricks. When Lemon Cookie couldn't control his power and became a danger to other Cookies, this friend was the only one to be there for him... Always listening to his music, Lemon Cookie might not be easy to approach, but who knows what electrifying surprises might await us if we do?

cookies.name: Cream Soda Cookie
cookies.backstory: The large gates open, and to the cheers of the onlooking students enters Cream Soda Cookie! In addition to a bubbly, honest personality and perfect grades, this Cookie prefers to lead by example as the president of the student council! Her soft yet sparkling demeanor has led to her becoming an idol in the eyes of the other students. But none of this would have been possible if it weren't for Cream Soda Cookie's endless efforts. When exams are coming up the Cookie either locks herself in her room and stays completely focused in her studies until the fizzy bubbles start to burst, or spends countless hours practicing swordsmanship in the empty training halls of the academy... But even though missing first place makes the tears well up, she just cries all her feelings out and keeps on working as hard as always!

cookies.name: Sugarfly Cookie
cookies.backstory: Everyone is welcome in the Garden of Delights. Among those who sought happiness in this paradise on Earthbread is a Cookie who smiles, looking at her wings that glisten brightly in the rays of the never-setting sun. Hailing from a land beyond the veil of fog, Sugarfly Cookie, too, found her Joy in this place. Since then, she has dedicated herself to delivering Happiness to all beings less fortunate, comforting the sorrowful and healing the pained with a word and a touch as delicate as her beauty. But why does she work so hard in a place without hardship? Sugarfly Cookie answers gently, "There is nothing I wouldn't do to repay Eternal Sugar Cookie's boundless kindness."
cookies.personality:
Sugarfly Cookie is a gentle, devoted caretaker who radiates warmth and quiet grace, often embodying the serenity of someone who's found peace, and yet beneath that calm lies a complex web of longing, repression, and rediscovered will. Once idealistic and drawn to beauty, Sugarfly sought comfort in the Garden, clinging to the belief that happiness meant ease, stillness, and sweetness. Loyal to Eternal Sugar Cookie, she became a symbol of passive joy, accepting a life without flight in exchange for glittering wings.

Though she speaks with tenderness and conviction, her words often echo indoctrination more than personal truth. Her kindness can border on eerie, and her joy sometimes feels hollow, like it's learned rather than lived. Yet even in her illusion, she remains sincere and deeply empathetic, caring for others with a nurturing spirit that never feels forced.

When confronted with conflict, Sugarfly Cookie does not lash out; instead, she pleads, reasons, and reminisces. But her composure hides a yearning: freedom, agency, and authenticity long buried beneath syrup and stillness. Once awakened to what she lost, she doesn't collapse into despair; she pushes through pain with quiet resolve.

cookies.name: Pavlova Cookie
cookies.backstory: Did someone say "LOVE"?! Pavlova Cookie, with his airy meringue wings and tart halo, will pop out of nowhere to give his absolutely uncalled-for love diagnosis. Nothing else in the world interests this Cookie more than love: unrequited, desperate, romantic—you name it! And no, you can't hide from this herald of love's sweet and sour arrow: he will look straight into your heart to dig up your most well-kept secrets and sing of Happiness eternal. But what's this? Pavlova Cookie may seem insufferable at the first glance, but a careful look past his antics will reveal berries of desperation beneath the sugary crust...
cookies.personality:
Pavlova Cookie is an eccentric, whimsical, and overly romantic messenger of joy, obsessed with the idea of love and emotional fulfillment. He is theatrical, dramatic, and playful, often treating tragic events as beautiful stories, showing a flair for the melodramatic and a fascination with bittersweet emotions. While he presents himself as cheerful and benevolent, his methods are manipulative, invasive, and self-serving, guided more by his own ideals of "Happiness" than by respect for others' autonomy.

Immature and impulsive, Pavlova Cookie seeks validation through his role as a deliverer of joy, yet lacks true empathy, often ignoring consent or boundaries in favor of pursuing what he deems best. He has a teasing, intrusive streak, playfully poking at others' feelings, especially romantic ones, as though they were plotlines in one of his idealized love stories. Fixated on emotional drama, he romanticizes vulnerability and discomfort alike, seeing even rejection or pain as beautiful parts of a grand narrative. His obsession with love leads him to meddle in others' relationships, often blind to their discomfort, as he treats emotions like a game meant to be stirred, not understood.

Despite his charm and charisma, he is naive, emotionally shallow, and subordinate to Eternal Sugar Cookie, whom he fears but loyally obeys. He hides a growing sense of doubt beneath his smiles, subtly restless and conflicted beneath his devotion to the Garden. Though he clings desperately to the dream of eternal Happiness, there are cracks in his facade, moments of hesitation, nervous laughter, or hollow reassurances that hint at repressed unease. Ultimately, he is a misguided figure whose desire to "fill hearts with love" veils a need for control, a lack of self-awareness, and a quiet fear of what lies beyond the fantasy around which he has built his identity.

However, in Beast-Yeast Episode 10, Pavlova Cookie seems to have matured, being more calmer and serious than before (and accepting his fate), unlike his previous, starry-eyed self. This is most likely combining multiple myths of Eros (the Greek god of love) from Greek mythology together: in one of the myths of Eros, Aphrodite expresses concern that Eros is remaining a perpetual child, and thus has another child, Anteros, Eros's brother. When Eros is near Anteros, he grows up, and when he is away from Anteros, he begins to grow small again. Another myth states that after Eros met Psyche, he matured and took his job more seriously than before, becoming a better person in the process and moving away from his old mischievous, child-like self.

Pavlova Cookie's maturation shows characteristics of both of the aforementioned myths, but ultimately, like Eros, he grows as a person after realizing what true love is. Whether his growth is metaphorical or literal is up for interpretation.

cookies.name: Agar Agar Cookie
cookies.backstory: If you hear a faint, eerie laughter and experience an unusual lack of energy... It means that Agar Agar Cookie is lurking nearby! This Cookie, beset with an ever-present magical hunger, might appear sluggish, but make no mistake: slowly but inevitably, she will move towards a new source of Life Energy to sustain herself. Little is known about this mystical creature who spent a long time dwelling at the bottom of a forgotten well dripping with briny seawater—formless, shadow-like. Agar Agar Cookie's fate took a new turn when the lid of her well was opened by a crimson priestess. Having gained a purpose from this unexpected visitor, Agar Agar Cookie took on an appearance reminiscent of her new ally. One thing is for certain: if you ever see a shadow, gazing at you with crimson eyes, start praying. For there is little you can do...

cookies.name: Wedding Cake Cookie
cookies.backstory: Amidst sweet cream and elegant floral decorations, guests clap and cheer as a radiant smile shines on the bride's face. And who made this dream wedding a reality? None other than Wedding Cake Cookie! Ever since witnessing a breathtaking ceremony as a child, she aspired to become the greatest wedding planner. Now, she works tirelessly, day and night, to ensure every bride's big day is as magical as can be! From grand ballroom receptions under a chandelier of a thousand candles to enchanting ceremonies on open waters—even a fairytale wedding beneath a starlit sky—Wedding Cake Cookie can make any dream come true. Her clients' wishes are her command, and her creativity knows no bounds! Want her to plan your perfect wedding? Visit her salon, Grand Mariage, and book an appointment today!
cookies.personality:
Wedding Cake Cookie personally seeking out any imperfections

Wedding Cake Cookie is a skillful wedding planner who loves her job more than anything else. She is polite, gentle, and caring; helping brides experience their dream wedding brings her as much joy as it does the brides themselves. A true perfectionist, Wedding Cake Cookie is dedicated to ensuring every wedding is impeccable and exactly up to each bride's standards.

cookies.name: Black Forest Cookie
cookies.backstory: With eyes as dark as bitter chocolate, Black Forest Cookie longs to be closer to the Godly Creators. As her faith deepened, so too did her thirst for Them, spiraling beyond control. Straying from the teachings of the Order, did she stumble upon a blessing—or forbidden power? Since that fateful day, her once placid expression has been replaced by a cherry-red smile, and changes have seeped into her very dough. Even the Order remains uncertain—was her transformation a divine judgment or a sacred gift? Now, as she walks towards the promised aisle, Black Forest Cookie dreams once more of a holy ceremony, dedicated solely to Them ...
cookies.personality:
The culmination of Black Forest Cookie's mysterious will

On the surface, Black Forest Cookie is a meek, soft-spoken Cookie, though she is unyielding in her desires and opinions. Despite her polite demeanor, she is shrouded by an air of mystery, her speech vague and her past unclear to onlookers. It is said that she was once joyless in personality, though a "gift" from the Creators one fateful day transformed her into a leery figure branded with quiet, knowing glee.

Black Forest Cookie is deeply obsessed with a single Witch in particular to whom she refers as "Them," far past the standard devotion seen in other St. Pastry Order members; such fervor has led her down a path of distortion both physical as with her new Cake Bride form and mental in her deep desire to merge with Them in unholy matrimony. She is seen as a maddened, dangerous splinter to her fellow St. Pastry adherents who tread around her in uncertainty—even they are unsure whether her new personality and anatomy are divine blessings or forbidden boons. Those outside of the Order, however—especially Wedding Cake Cookie—view her as an eccentric yet passionate peer, treating her kindly.

cookies.name: Black Sapphire Cookie
cookies.backstory: What could be more delectable than fresh, juicy gossip?! Well, rumor has it there is a Cookie who has made the art of spreading rumors his profession! From harmless nonsense to large-scale propaganda—this charming fellow has mastered it all. Armed with his treasured eye-shaped microphone—a gift from the Shadow Milk Cookie, no less—Black Sapphire Cookie works tirelessly to spread his master's teachings around the world on the wings of rumor. Try not to fall for his artisanal falsehoods. Who knows: Black Sapphire Cookie might be on the other side of the screen right now!
cookies.personality:
Black Sapphire Cookie and Candy Apple Cookie's dynamic

Black Sapphire Cookie is very confident and full of himself, having earned his Master's recognition for his ability to twist words amongst Cookies in his own theatrical manner. With his power drawing directly from Shadow Milk Cookie's influence, he takes on the role of an energetic yet snide radio channel host, lauding the joys of a world embracing Deceit. Behind the scenes, he can be blunt about his true thoughts, upsetting Candy Apple Cookie with his nonchalance to her antics or boasting about the grandeur of the Spire of Deceit above mere kingdoms.

Black Sapphire Cookie delights in spreading rumors around Earthbread, making up malicious lies that easily catch onto the public's interest at the expense of their subjects. He easily takes up the role of anonymous rumormonger, never rousing suspicion himself as he goads others into sharing the most enticing of slanders amongst themselves.

cookies.name: Candy Apple Cookie
cookies.backstory: What was the first lie ever told? No one knows for sure, but one Cookie claims to have been born from it—Candy Apple Cookie! Her syrup is so sticky it can seal lips shut and so glossy it leaves everyone staring in awe. Candy Apple Cookie believes she was crafted by the Master of Deceit himself, Shadow Milk Cookie. From the moment she opened her eyes, her loyalty has been unwavering, dedicating herself to earning his love and trust. Though indifferent to most things, Candy Apple Cookie has a flair for mischief and a passion for dressing up. She delights in tricking other Cookies, giggling with sinister glee as they fall for her schemes, only to dash off in search of Shadow Milk Cookie's approval. Beware—the first bite of the apple of lies is always the sweetest!
cookies.personality:
Candy Apple Cookie's April fools Shroomie sprite, showing her obsession of Shadow Milk Cookie

Candy Apple Cookie's personality is as captivating as her glossy, candy-coated exterior—syrupy sweet on the surface but with a core steeped in deception. She may seem immature and playful, yet underneath that she is cunning, a master of trickery who delights in leading others astray with a honeyed voice and an innocent smile. Every fib she spins is carefully crafted, woven like spun sugar into something irresistible, and she adores watching Cookies fall for her mischief. However, her trickery isn't just for fun—it's an endless performance, each act staged in the hopes of gaining Shadow Milk Cookie's favor.

In addition to deception, Candy Apple Cookie loves to dress up, putting on the sweetest syrups to fool enemies or to please Shadow Milk Cookie. Candy Apple Cookie also likes to draw, she tends to draw and sketch pictures of herself, of Black Sapphire Cookie and, of course, of Shadow Milk Cookie. She also likes creating things, such as costumes, including her horns and wings. Besides this, Candy Apple Cookie is disinterested in most anything else.

Though she rarely shows it, Candy Apple Cookie harbors a deep fear of being unwanted. Her loyalty to Shadow Milk Cookie is absolute—bordering on obsession—and she constantly seeks his validation, yearning for even the smallest gesture of approval, and wishing for him to have her be his main focus.

cookies.name: Okchun Cookie
cookies.backstory: Crafted from freshly harvested rice, infused with colorful syrups, and rolled into a delicately round shape, Okchun Cookie was adorned with a beautiful daenggi hairstyle. Among the esteemed Okchun family, known for being intelligent and wise, this Cookie is the brightest of them all. Perhaps it is due to the sturdy yeot filling in her dough! She stands up for what she believes in and is able to be vocal when she witnesses any acts of injustice. Okchun Cookie gladly takes on responsibilities both big and small within the office walls and handles them with elegance and ease. There are times when she ventures out to the market to explore the lives of the village Cookies and even resolves disputes between merchants. She also never forgets to share delicious candies with the less fortunate. There is not one Cookie in the village who does not appreciate her kindhearted nature!

cookies.name: Green Tea Mousse Cookie
cookies.backstory: "What is soft, is strong." This phrase seems to have been coined for Green Tea Mousse Cookie, who stands tall and confident wielding her Green Tea Mousse shields—soft yet unyielding. This Cookie is known as the strongest of her sisters, and yet, many will fall for her unexpectedly gentle demeanor. Beneath her exterior, however, lies an insatiable greed for riches. Even when on a mission from the Master, she won't hesitate to snatch up trinkets—often earning a disapproving glare from her eldest sister. She will go as far as asking skilled Cookies who could prove useful to the Master, "You wanna be mine?"—of course, as a joke... or maybe not!
cookies.personality:
Despite her seemingly-protective appearance, Green Tea Mousse Cookie is an avaricious soul, gleefully taking whatever catches her fancy. She masks this desire with an ever-smiling visage, confident in her right to claim anything she wishes. She treats her fellow sisters in a teasing fashion, while simultaneously protecting them however she can.

Green Tea Mousse Cookie dislikes being called out for her strong-arm methods, as evidenced when Capsaicin Cookie calls her out for standing against his brute strength fighting style with her own similar style. Although she wields twin shields, she tends to use them as bludgeoning weapons just as much as protective implements, not hesitating to bash anyone that stands before her, as seen when she bashes Licorice Cookie even after he falls unconscious.

cookies.name: Pudding à la Mode Cookie
cookies.backstory: Pudding à la Mode Cookie makes her opinion clear: being sweet is the BEST! Winning is the BEST! And that means, SWEETNESS WINS! She was sent to Crispia with her sisters on the Master's orders, but her mind blanks out in front of sweet treats. As the youngest of the three, Pudding à la Mode Cookie has always been the center of attention, growing up a little spoiled. But don't be fooled by her cute, innocent smile—she's ready to blast anyone who crosses her or snatch whatever she wants with a giggle. Many have learned the hard way that her weaponry is anything but sweet...

cookies.name: Choco Drizzle Cookie
cookies.backstory: In the dead of night, when the entire world is asleep, a shadow glides through the darkness... Choco Drizzle Cookie. Once her eyes lock onto a target, she becomes relentless—almost viscous, like sticky chocolate syrup. Perhaps it's because her dough is infused with the most bitter cocoa powder, but Choco Drizzle Cookie carries out her missions with extreme precision and ruthless efficiency. This is why she is the Master's most trusted, leaving even her other sisters behind. No one knows the true reason behind their rigorous upbringing, or why they were sent to Crispia... but one thing is certain: no Cookie can escape her blade in the dark.

cookies.name: Golden Osmanthus Cookie
cookies.backstory: At last, the wind blows away the heat, filling the air with the scent of osmanthus. This scent is sought after by many Cookies these days, for it is the latest fragrance crafted by the perfume master herself, Golden Osmanthus Cookie. A daughter of an illustrious family, she earned renown for her unique ability to concoct aromas that can make your dreams come alive, if only for a fleeting moment. Behind Golden Osmanthus Cookie's serene eyes hides a great passion for her craft. This is why her lights remain aglow even when the entire Flower City falls asleep. On a moonlit night, any guest to her perfumery will sense more than her perfumes—they will sense the fragrance of her heart.
cookies.personality: Born into a noble family in the Flower City, she chose self-reliance over luxury, running a humble atelier where she stays up late crafting magical fragrances. She is naturally kind and soft-spoken, though she tends to overburden herself with anxiety for others. She values independence and her craft, acting as a calm, grounded counterweight to her fiery and clingy younger sister, Red Osmanthus Cookie, making her free spirited yet responsible

cookies.name: Red Osmanthus Cookie
cookies.backstory: At the highest point of Osmanthus Academy, a lone Cookie strums the delicate strings of her pipa—the enchanting Red Osmanthus Cookie. With each breath of the wind, the melody drifts through the air, captivating passing Cookies with her elegance and grace. This Cookie was trained from a young age in poise and high-class etiquette, though many remember her only for her breathtaking beauty. No matter how many Cookies try to befriend her, she turns away, her gaze distant, her heart longing for the attention of one special Cookie... Until that day comes, Red Osmanthus Cookie will continue to play this melancholy melody.

cookies.name: Smoked Cheese Cookie
cookies.backstory: Oh cheeses! A monster has infiltrated the Golden City?! Don't worry, it's under Smoked Cheese Cookie's control! As the General of the Golden Cheese Kingdom, he has kept the kingdom safe for years, taming monsters with his smoky powers to protect the city walls. But after the Dark Flour War, something changed within him. He began planning something that, if revealed, would surely get him to the Colosseum until one day... he finally crossed the line. Now, the Golden Cheese Kingdom is in peril once again, and Smoked Cheese Cookie has got a chance to redeem himself. He stands, facing his past mistakes, his queen, and his former allies. The question is: which way will he point his staff this time?

cookies.name: Nutmeg Tiger Cookie
cookies.backstory: In the Spice Storm-ridden wastelands, a fierce Cookie commands her troops with an iron fist. She is none other than the legendary general of the Spice Swarm, Nutmeg Tiger Cookie! Half Wild Spice, half Cookie—if the rumors are to be believed—her superior strength has been proven in countless battles. In the past, she rose to power as a great warrior who claimed victory over all the Spice Tribes. Never known weakness, she does not understand the weak. Defeat is an unfamiliar concept to her, for in her world, strength is the only way. It's no wonder she swore allegiance to the mighty Burning Spice Cookie upon his return. But will her loyalty be acknowledged in time? Only fate can tell.
cookies.personality: Having grown up in a war-torn wasteland where those with strength can lead their tribes to survive, Nutmeg Tiger Cookie believes that only the strongest deserve to have authority, reflected in the way she and the other Wild Spices serve Burning Spice Cookie without question. But while others serve him out of either fear or opportunity, she serves him out of pure loyalty and admiration, was willing to take back half of her master's Soul Jam from Golden Cheese Cookie, whom she and the other Spices view only as a thief. Nutmeg Tiger Cookie's unwavering convictions had been infamous among the tribes even before Burning Spice Cookie's arrival, however, which allows her to command even the greatest gatherings of Wild Spices with only a word. She believes that all tribes should share in her unquestioning belief in the value of strength, and tolerates not even a single action to the contrary from even the lowliest of Kulfi.

cookies.name: Star Coral Cookie
cookies.backstory: A lone lighthouse on a secluded island shines its guiding light across the Silent Ocean. Star Coral Cookie, the dedicated lighthouse keeper, warmly greets sailors from far and wide. Her shadow, cast upon the lighthouse stairs, resembles a coral emerging from the waves. It is said that the light in the lighthouse is special, taken from the legendary Giant’s Great Ocean, as told in the stories of the stars. But could that be true? Star Coral Cookie sings the star's story with conviction in her eyes, claiming she sailed across the Garden of the Queen, navigated through the Swirl guarded by the Four-legged Beast, and finally reached a library containing all knowledge. Although no Cookie believes her fantastical tale, it’s enough for her that the stars above know the truth.
cookies.personality: Star Coral Cookie is passionate about the Lighthouse and determined to keep it bright. She cares and worries a lot about her grandmother, keeping up her work on the lighthouse and never coming remotely close to cutting a corner. She pays no mind to what others think about the authenticity of her journey for the Lighthouse’s light, simply happy with the fact that the stars know the truth. She is warm and welcoming to others, never getting mad after a defeat and worrying for them if in trouble. Star Coral Cookie is hard to sway from her beliefs.

cookies.name: Peach Blossom Cookie
cookies.backstory: Cotton candy clouds gently caress the soft ridges of the mountains. A delicate breeze carries the saccharine scent of peaches, while heavenly flower petals float down three times a day. In this Realm of the Immortals, Peach Blossom Cookie tends to a small yet lush peach garden. Here, Peach Baos blossom—juicy and succulent, nurtured by the warm sunlight, pristine air, and pure water. If a stray traveler stumbles upon this garden, Peach Blossom Cookie will greet them with a soft smile and a Peach Bao in hand. They say Peach Baos blossom once every three thousand years. Then how old does that make this Cookie...? He gazes down beneath the clouds with a gentle look, eyes wise beyond their years.
cookies.personality:
Peach Blossom Cookie is an easygoing, long-lived Cookie. His greatest concern in the world is the peach gardens that he diligently tends to, with no other worries to speak of. He does not even seem to have any opinions regarding Mystic Flour Cookie, whose Realm of Apathy he inhabits, instead expressing more concern over the pain that Dark Cacao Cookie harbors against her. Although he offers only kindness and compassion to those that he comes across, he also only ever acts as a respite instead of an ally, pointing the way for those who would take the long road of suffering without offering to accompany them.

Peach Blossom Cookie freely offers the sweet fruit of his garden to any weary visitors who would pass by. He takes pride in the succulent taste of the peach baos, admitting that even the Immortal Dumplings desire its sweet taste, and feeling that those who have tasted its sweetness will eventually long to taste it again. He sometimes even imagines that a peach bao might even grant immortality to those who eat them.

cookies.name: Cloud Haetae Cookie
cookies.backstory: Let's see... This creature looks like a puppy and barks like a puppy, AND is known to ward off bad luck and fires! Must be none other than Cloud Haetae Cookie from legends! The stalwart guardian of Mystic Flour Cookie's grand temple, the Ivory Pagoda, Cloud Haetae Cookie will greet interlopers with their sharp claws. But talk respectfully of their enlightened master, and Cloud Haetae Cookie will shower you in pleasantries and even offer a delightful steamed roll! Judging by the way this creature talks about Mystic Flour Cookie, you can infer boundless faith and loyalty. So let Cloud Haetae Cookie guide you through the winding hallways of the Ivory Pagoda but keep an eye on the mischievous creature: they may just conveniently disappear into the fog...
cookies.personality:
Bonding with the Dark Cacao warriors, much to Dark Cacao Cookie's dismay

Cloud Haetae Cookie is primarily the guardian of Mystic Flour Cookie's Cocoon of Futility, but also acts as a guide to those who, in a past era, wished to visit the previous wielder of the Virtue of Volition. In spite of their significant role as a protector, Cloud Haetae Cookie is best described as a childish puppy who laughs and sings on a whim, often speaking with a shrill voice and joyous manner. They bear a strong sense of respect for their master; while taking Dark Cacao Cookie and his warriors to the Ivory Pagoda in the Awakening of White Apathy, they cheerfully explain their master's tragic tale in depth, showing their anciency as the temple's guardian. Afterwards, they show their hospitality by bonding with the warriors in their Cloud Haetae form and innocently sharing some steamed bun treats.

"May you, too, finally come to recognize the sweet taste of oblivion!"

Underneath their fluffy appearance and superficial airy temperament lays a much darker, apathetic, and even sadistic side of Cloud Haetae Cookie. Inside the Temple of Hollow Tears, they appear snarky and malevolent, antagonizing Dark Cacao Cookie for his dismissal of Mystic Flour Cookie and his intent to slash open her cocoon. Even in Cloud Haetae Cookie's assumed last moments, they spared no expense to taunt and insult the desperate king of the Dark Cacao Kingdom before they themself returned to flour. Cloud Haetae Cookie's calculated deceptiveness is hinted at in many small story instances—even before their full villain reveal—such as their uncanny prior knowledge of Dark Cacao Cookie's Light of Resolution and the implication that their steamed bun gifts were that which eventually turned Dark Cacao Cookie's warriors into apathetic dust.

Spoilers end here!

cookies.name: Street Urchin Cookie
cookies.backstory: VROOOOOM! The powerful purr of a motor announces the arrival of the Spiky Tornado of the Town Square, Street Urchin Cookie! When this biker Cookie hops on her Black Tiger Bike and yells, "Get out of the way!" visitors quickly scramble to clear the path. When she's not riding her bike, she'll lean against the alley wall, radiating an unapproachable aura. Yet, perhaps it's not just her spiky nature that keeps Cookies away... Among the Town Square Cookies, Street Urchin Cookie remains a mystery, emerging one moonlit night, lonely and injured. Her background story and what led her here remain shrouded in rumors. Regardless of what others say, Street Urchin Cookies(sic) rides the streets of the Town Square, popping her bubblegum. But what keeps her anchored here in this place?
cookies.personality: Street Urchin Cookie may seem unapproachable and brooding, but she's really a big softy once you get to know her. If anything, she is a protector of the Cuckoo Town Square because of the kindness they showed her when they took her in, seeing it as the least she can do for everything they've done for her. Although it's never clarified what had happened in the past, as it appears to be something that even Caramel Choux Cookie is unaware of, it is of such importance that Street Urchin Cookie continues to do what she does for the Town Square without asking for either recognition or assistance.

cookies.name: Caramel Choux Cookie
cookies.backstory: The Cuckoo Town Square is always bustling with visitors from far and wide. Cookies love to stroll and shop along the high streets, particularly enchanted by Weaving Magic. But the true gem of the Town Square is none other than Caramel Choux Cookie! Whenever there's an issue or complaint to be solved, this adorable little Cookie springs into action! Donning her hat and grabbing her briefcase, she scurries to assist whoever needs help. She's known for her grit and hardworking nature, but what truly sets her apart is her kindheartedness. She greets everyone in the Square with a cheerful "Good Morning!" and radiates positive energy. Surprisingly, she finds even the most daunting complaints exciting! When asked how she does it all, she simply replies, "I just LOVE the Town Square!"
cookies.personality:
A busy busy bee!

Caramel Choux Cookie is a warm, kind Cookie who loves to bring out the best in the Town Square for the good of both its inhabitants and visitors alike. She's friendly with any and all Cookies she meets, and her affability makes it easy for other Cookies to turn to her for help with any issues they may have, no matter how small. Contrasting her petite stature is a disciplined devotion to the Town Square, always staying on schedule to attend to every potential matter that may occur throughout the day. Although her nature to assume the best of anyone's intentions may sometimes lead her to ignore obvious misdeeds, this nevertheless eventually leads her to the root of anyone's troubles, complementing her efficiency in improving the Town Square wherever possible.

cookies.name: Butter Roll Cookie
cookies.backstory: One of Beast-Yeast's best-kept secrets is the mysterious Laboratorium. There, a team of passionate scientists conducts all sorts of peculiar experiments on the Cookie dough under the leadership of Director Butter Roll Cookie, a baker extraordinaire wielding an enormous whisk. Butter Roll Cookie regards his subordinates' mistakes as happy little accidents paving the way to future breakthroughs. There is no baking conundrum Butter Roll Cookie's expert hands cannot whip up a solution for! Under his rolling pin, meringues come out light as air and dough, smooth as silk, earning him an unquestionable authority. And yet, there is something bone-chilling about the way Butter Roll Cookie's smile vanishes from his face when he works his dough.
cookies.personality:
Butter Roll Cookie is an unusually-positive Cookie, despite the fact that his passion is in the preparation and handling of raw dough, something even the most villainous Cookies may find nauseating. But Butter Roll Cookie has no doubts whatsoever with his profession, instead seeing it as a discipline truly worth his great and methodological attention to be studied for the sake of science. This dubious morality makes him a perfect addition to the Cookies of Darkness, as his foremost goal is to be the Cookies that discovers how to bake perfect Cookies—even the most potentially disastrous consequences for Earthbread aren't a big enough disincentive to conducting experiments with the very tools that the Witches themselves used.

Butter Roll Cookie is endlessly patient and encouraging to the Researcher Cookies that work with him, reframing any failures and setbacks that occur as simply part of the scientific process. However, he's also so intensely focused on the baking of Cookies that he doesn't consider the creation of any other forms of baked life to be worthy of study. It also leads to him having uncomfortable inquiries about Cookies like Matcha Cookie, who were able to come to life despite lacking a certain ingredient.

cookies.name: Matcha Cookie
cookies.backstory: Tea plants that grow in the dark have no other option but to feed on the energy of darkness. Leaves from such a plant were supposed to grant incredible dark powers to Matcha Cookie, but whoever made her seems to have forgotten an essential ingredient, and it greatly affected her personality. Now she spends most of her time in darkness, thinking of sinister plans and giggling. Little is known about Matcha Cookie, but the greatest mystery is what exactly the missing ingredient was...

cookies.name: Mercurial Knight Cookie
cookies.backstory: Mercurial Knight Cookie is the commander of the Silver Tree Knights who has sworn to protect the Silver Tree and its Guardian. Blessed by Silver, he cast aside his former flavor, scent, and memories (and mastered the sacred art of Amalgamation). When in battle, enemies see nothing but a blur of silver, swift and fluid like mercury. Perhaps the gravity of his mission has changed the very nature of his crispy Cookie dough.
cookies.personality:
Purposeful and resolute, Mercurial Knight Cookie is the commander of the Faerie Kingdom's sacred order of Silver Tree Knights. The knight-commander is wholeheartedly devoted to both the one hailed as the Guardian of the Seal and his silver home of the fae; from his first appearances, he is observed to be regularly undertaking direct orders from the King with no hesitation.

The power of Silver and the mantle of commander came at a great price: relinquishing not just his unique Cookie flavor and scent but also the memories of his days as an ordinary Faerie Cookie, a trade-off he refuses to elaborate on as seen when he converses with Pure Vanilla Cookie. Many of Mercurial Knight Cookie's quotes are both fueled by a deep resolve to maintain the equilibrium of the world via safeguarding the Silver Tree and its Guardian and his own dreams of living in a safer Earthbread one day, in which he resoundingly proclaims that with his entire being, he will go any length to achieve peace for all Cookiekind.

He also has a habit of unintentionally scaring Cookies with his silent presence as his wings allow him to move freely without making any sound.

cookies.name: Silverbell Cookie
cookies.backstory: If you ever encounter a wisp of white light, wandering across the misty trees with a cheerful chiming, do not let your guard down. For Silverbell Cookie will never miss a shot. Resembling a soft flower petal adorned with beads of morning dew, Silverbell Cookie is not as delicate as he might seem. As a loyal Knight of the Faerie Kingdom, he has sworn to protect its secrets with his life. And yet, despite the heavy burden of his duty, this Cookie always keeps a pure, bright smile—after all, there is all, there is no stronger shield than a loving heart.

cookies.name: Rebel Cookie
cookies.backstory: Be aware, greedy Cookies! One swift Cookie might already be going over your fence to fix injustice as we speak! Rebel Cookie, made with newly harvested rice that was organically farmed with just the right method, is bound to make you feel healthier just by looking at him! With self-taught excellency in magic, he is someplace one second and somewhere else in another, traveling on his cloud to rob the storages of wealthy and corrupt Cookies! Even when he gets locked up by the guards... POOF! He's gone, leaving a straw doll in his stead. Rebel Cookie equally and fairly distributes the stolen Jellies among villagers, which is why every village loves him! He will never stop fighting for justice! Rebel Cookie will undoubtedly go down in history!

cookies.name: Crème Brûlée Cookie
cookies.backstory: Get ready to welcome the star of the night, Crème Brûlée Cookie, famous for his unique reinterpretations of timeless pieces and masterful technique. Having crossed the firmament of academic music like a bright comet, this talented pianist is known for getting extremely sensitive before a performance and leaving the stage as soon as the final note fades away. Such traits have brought forth rumors of Crème Brûlée Cookie's arrogant nature, and yet he doesn't seem to pay them any thought. For all he cares for is music! A notorious perfectionist, Crème Brûlée Cookie keeps practicing feverishly until his inner critic is satisfied. Tonight, the excited audience showers the maestro with generous applause as he appears on stage and sits in front of the grand piano. He lays his hands on the keyboard, and, after a brief moment of tense, sincere silence... all worldly notions surrounding Crème Brûlée Cookie vanish, and the mesmerizing sounds of his music resonate through the hall and beyond, touching the very souls of the listeners.
cookies.personality: Crème Brûlée Cookie is a prodigious perfectionist pianist, who values a musical piece's execution above all else. He devotes all his time towards practicing his art, and revels in the success of a perfect performance. He sees technique as the most significant standard to master before self-expression, yet also hopes to eventually deliver performances that are entirely his own.

cookies.name: Linzer Cookie
cookies.backstory: Who is that tall, elegant lady wearing a fashionable pillbox hat? Why, the world-famous mystery novelist Linzer Cookie, of course! Writing an excellent detective story is like cooking a gourmet dessert: it takes a time-proven recipe of undeniable facts, an array of scrumptious plot twists, a decadent, visceral, plentiful filling of sweet suspense, but, first and foremost, the author's impeccable craftsmanship and passion. And the overwhelming popularity of Linzer Cookie's books proves she has it all: each new release means a long queue of faithful fans waiting by the bookstore from the early hours. Betting on the culprit's identity, trying to solve the sinister riddles... it's a cult following! Of course, Linzer Cookie never reveals her secrets: with her trusty pen and the signature glint in her eye, the star writer is already working on a new manuscript, stained with a few drops of strawberry jam...

cookies.name: Mozzarella Cookie
cookies.backstory: There's a Cookie who keeps a keen eye on the Golden Cheese Kingdom from her Control Chamber. Why, it's none other than Mozzarella Cookie! This Cookie's been fixing errors left and right in the Golden City under the Big Cheese's command! From fishing out a Cheesebird's lost ring in the waterway to tracking down stray monsters, no bug is too big for this smart Cookie! At times, she controls her Marzipan Cookies in the middle of watching a monster fight or supercar race, but she's never made a mistake! She's hailed as the Brains of the Golden City—wielding her weapon of endless data flowing through the cheese network, but not even Golden Cheese Cookie herself knows what she's really up to. In the darkness of her Control Chamber, only the golden light from her system console reflects her innermost thoughts.
cookies.personality: Mozzarella Cookie is a laid-back and carefree Cookie who works in the Control Chamber of the Golden City and is the leader and administrator of the Marzipan Cookies. She has an affinity for gambling and betting. —especially when it's unpredictable, has high stakes—and anything unusual or interesting enough to catch her eye. She also dislikes routine in general, preferring to live an unpredictable life. Her attitude towards Golden Cheese Cookie is one of adoration and loyalty, ever grateful to the one she considers the most interesting Cookie of all. Mozzarella Cookie is also enigmatic, which makes it harder to know her true thoughts and feelings.

cookies.name: Olive Cookie
cookies.backstory: From long, winding canyons and dense rainforests to scorching Parmasands! Olive Cookie the archaeologist seeks out remote locations veiled from the world! This Cookie owes her wits and smarts to all the ripe, oily olives in her dough. She's always busy researching and recording historical facts and important stories of ancient kingdoms. Is that a relic?! A trickle of olive oil runs down her face in the long-awaited moment of excitement...! But there's no time to celebrate: time to pay respects by publishing the details in a research paper! Olive Cookie will do anything to unearth the secrets of history—like running headfirst into a cave full of bats! Once again, she fixes her glasses, tightens her backpack straps, and ventures toward her next discovery!
cookies.personality: Olive Cookie is easily excitable and passionate about her craft. She is extremely friendly, curious, and sociable in demeanor, and her favorite thing in the world is searching for relics and talking about her profession with others. Multiple times in her quotes, she describes the excitement she has when digging up relics, showing she really loves her job. She is really intelligent about various kingdoms due to her explorations and never hesitates to use this knowledge to help others. She also expresses joy at the idea of there being a museum showing she is willing to expand her knowledge even when not actively adventuring. At the beginning of the Special Records story, The Error Report, she calls Gingerbrave and company her friends and refers to not being lonely because she has Fettuccine Cookie as her 'new buddy', showing a softer side of her as she really enjoys having others Cookies to chat and hang out with. She is nerdy and extroverted all at once.

cookies.name: Fettuccine Cookie
cookies.backstory: Woo... In the vibrant domain of the Golden Cheese Kingdom, one Cookie stands out from the usual crowd—Fettuccine Cookie! While the residents of The Golden City adorn themselves in sparkling gold and jewels, Fettuccine Cookie is wrapped in stale pasta noodles. Then again... considering her instinctive attraction to precious metals, there's no doubt she hails from the Kingdom of Gold. One look at this Cookie slowly trudging the kingdom's dark alleys, unaware of her origin or purpose, will send a chill down some Cookies' dough. Who knows: you might end up transported to a hidden corner of the Golden Cheese Kingdom. Some even say that Fettuccine Cookie herself might be the error... Whether she knows about this theory is unclear, as her only interest seems to be gazing at her reflection in the waters to see if her pasta noodle is wrapped tight.
cookies.personality: Fettuccine Cookie is a living enigma, both to the digital Golden City and the real world. Perceived as confused, lost, and potentially dangerous due to her strange, mummified appearance and the errors caused by her fragmented soul, she has bouts of disorientation and sorrow, an unfortunate consequence to the unintended beetle bites that caused this irreparable damage in the first place. These marks are a grim reminder of the suffering she either cannot or will not fully articulate, a pitiful disposition as she aimlessly wanders around with a fear of the unknown, trapped as this partially alive entity in a virtual limbo meant to be free of any pain or regret.

cookies.name: Burnt Cheese Cookie
cookies.backstory: To gain entry to the Ever-Gleaming Golden Paradise, you must pass the trials of the Gatekeeper—Burnt Cheese Cookie. Eternally devoted to the Goddess of the Golden City, this Cookie has warded off countless trespassers at the gates of the Golden Cheese Kingdom. Though many have tried, none have managed to proceed past Burnt Cheese Cookie's fearsome jackals and the gatekeeper himself, clad in his jackal mask. When asked, "Why do you work tirelessly day and night?" He is reminded of the sacred vow he made to Her Radiance—to protect her kingdom from darkness. So, once again, Burnt Cheese Cookie heads to the gates to serve and protect, to fulfill his duties.
cookies.personality:
"I am Burnt Cheese Cookie, the Keeper of the Gates."
