Burnt Cheese Cookie is the stoic gatekeeper of the Golden Cheese Kingdom. He stands guard at the gates with his loyal jackals, stopping anyone driven by “impure greed” from entering the Golden City. To pass through, one must first overcome his trials and prove their heart is pure.

Burnt Cheese Cookie has been part of the kingdom since its very creation, though he was much younger back then. Even after countless years of guarding the gates, he still holds deep respect for Her Radiance and remains fully devoted to her.

His loyalty to the kingdom and its queen is so strong that he’s willing to sacrifice himself to protect them if needed. In fact, this devotion is what led to his death during the Dark Flour War massacre. This is confirmed in Golden Cheese Cookie’s dialogue from “The Lost Golden City,” where she says, “Burnt Cheese Cookie... who crumbled protecting my land…”

While often described as “needlessly serious,” Burnt Cheese Cookie isn’t one for long talks, and his face rarely shows much emotion. Still, he clearly has a soft spot for his jackals. A loading screen even mentions that “Burnt Cheese Cookie spends his days off purchasing treats for his jackals and snakes!” He seems to understand and communicate with them, as seen in “The Error Report,” where he questions one of his jackals for neglecting the back entrance—and even reacts to its answer.

Beneath his stern and imposing nature, Burnt Cheese Cookie deeply cares for his companions. In “The Error Report,” when his jackals begin duplicating due to a strange error, he says, “It will not be easy to take care of all of you. But, of course… I will be more attentive to your needs.”

cookies.name: Frilled Jellyfish Cookie
cookies.backstory: "What news do you bring today, jellyfish?" Frilled Jellyfish Cookie asks her little friends coming from all corners of the sea first thing in the morning. There is no other Cookie in the entire kingdom of Tearcrown with a keener eye for cleanliness and beauty. Carried by seawater, Frilled Jellyfish Cookie appears wherever there is a need for tidying up. Perhaps it is thanks to her tireless efforts the scenery of the Kingdom of Merfolk is so breathtaking. Frilled Jellyfish Cookie's soft, Jelly-like body allows her to float anywhere in the Saccharine Sea, yet she has chosen to serve only one Cookie. When asked why, she always answers, "How could I not love someone full of life?"
cookies.personality: Frilled Jellyfish Cookie has a sweet and innocent appeal. She often appears to be cheerful and energetic, despite her calm appearance and voice. It is a known fact that Frilled Jellyfish Cookie adores White Pearl Cookie. Frilled Jellyfish Cookie often goes out of her way to mention White Pearl Cookie's beauty, grace, and magnificence.

cookies.name: Peppermint Cookie
cookies.backstory: Mint leaves for Peppermint Cookie were gathered from a town near the clear sea. This Cookie likes to spend time at the shore, staring dreamily at the horizon, or playing the shell ocarina. An old friend, the Peppermint Whale, often appears to the sound for company. Peppermint Cookie treasures the simple but unchanging things, just like the waves that come and go. May the Cookie's smile remain unchanging as well!

cookies.name: Black Lemonade Cookie
cookies.backstory: If you happen to pass by a dark basement and hear electrifying guitar sounds along with a fresh citrus scent, you might've just stumbled onto Black Lemonade Cookie's studio! She may look distant and aloof at times, but once she gets on stage, she's a whole new Cookie! With her signature two-tone lemon icing and energizing sound, every Cookie is bound to shake to the rhythm of her music. Some Cookies find Black Lemonade Cookie's music hard to follow, but everyone agrees that all of her songs are a labor of love and passion. and that's what matters to Black Lemonade Cookie, after all. No matter how dark and small the stage, she'll always continue to sing and give her everything for her dedicated fans!

cookies.name: Rockstar Cookie
cookies.backstory: Whaaaaam! Wacka wow! Inside the sizzling oven, Rockstar Cookie discovered the sound of rock 'n' roll. He realized that to move the audience, one must not only be talented but also feel the true Rock Spirit within! Many legendary hits were created with that philosophy in mind. Every Cookie who has seen Rockstar Cookie perform was changed forever. The blazing sound! The overwhelming charisma! The legend might have taken a path different from his earlier days filled with experimentation, but his Rock Spirit still resonates with everyone!
cookies.personality: Rockstar Cookie is described as a skilled musician who loves nothing more than sharing his art and its spirit with the world. While highly passionate about music, he is also a largely laid-back individual and handles high-tension situations with ease.

cookies.name: Tarte Tatin Cookie
cookies.backstory: Whether it's the past or the future of dragon hunting, you can be sure that Tarte Tatin Cookie is part of it! Years and years of carrying around her customized cannon on dragon hunts far and wide has helped build Tarte Tatin Cookie's reputation as an extremely skilled and experienced dragon hunter. The way she confronts the dragons, massive threats to all Cookiekind, without even a trace of fear is reminiscent of the Ancient Heroes. It inspires the Cookies around her and sets their battle spirit aflame! Tarte Tatin Cookie may seem hard to approach because of her aloof personality and serious attitude. But unlike her cold exterior, she has a warm side to her that means she never forgets a friend. After all, the best hunters are those who have a lot to protect. You're sure to find Tarte Tatin Cookie fighting another enormous beast somewhere again today, firing her cannon without hesitation. BOOM!
cookies.personality:
Tarte Tatin Cookie is an experienced, wizened dragon hunter who is very fond of and protective of Dragon City. She is shown to have a deep resentment of dragons, viewing them as threats to Cookies with the knowledge of their history with Cookies.

Tarte Tatin Cookie takes the job of a dragon hunter very seriously, preferring to work alone. She views the role of a dragon hunter as critical to the survival of Cookies, seeing it as eliminating the threat before it eliminates you.

cookies.name: Royal Margarine Cookie
cookies.backstory: When the shadow of the golden dragon glides over Dragon City, it is not fear and dread that fills the old alleyways, but rather excitement and anticipation. The famous Royal Margarine Cookie has arrived! Look at those sleek locks, jaunty attire, and the shiny butter knife tucked under his belt— there is no doubt that this Cookie is the last descendant of the legendary Dragon Rider Clan. Indeed, any seasoned dragon hunter will immediately know that his companion Buttercream is no dragon but a wyvern. But as long as Royal Margarine Cookie is using his dazzling smile as a distraction, such details are no longer of importance. Be careful, however: just one look at that smile is enough to make anyone fall for this handsome Dragon Rider!
cookies.personality:
Royal Margarine Cookie is shown to be a very flirtatious, charming, and perhaps even sleazy Cookie with his introductory scene in Legend of the Red Dragon immediately showing him enchanting a group of excited female Cookies. This extends to the strong-willed Hollyberry Cookie, with whom he tries to flirt multiple times. He is also quite cocky and boastful, especially about his dashing, rugged looks and his status as the last dragon rider of his clan, often parading about his dear Buttercream Wyvern like a show dog.

Growing as a Cookie, even when it's difficult

Underneath his suave exterior, Royal Margarine Cookie hides multiple insecurities, leading him to exaggerate his achievements. The most obvious one is that his supposed dragon Buttercream is actually just a wyvern. While drunk, he also reveals that he never became a real dragon rider, as he was too scared of the bellowing dragon roars as a 12-year-old child and met Buttercream by pure chance. In spite of his cowardice and dishonesty, Royal Margarine Cookie nevertheless always had a genuine desire to be a hero who helps fellow Cookies, seeming to fail at this through his own doubt in his abilities and worth as a Cookie. Eventually, he works towards this wish after rescuing an abandoned young Cookie in the Dragon City set ablaze and dedicating himself to helping the protagonists of Legend of the Red Dragon in defeating the false Red Dragon.

Despite his apparent fear of dragons, Royal Margarine Cookie harbors true care and love towards Buttercream, even beyond complimenting her to stoke his own false ego. He has stated himself that he "gives Buttercream a good back scratch every evening" and dotes on her even when the two are alone. As the two met while Royal Margarine Cookie (and in turn perhaps Buttercream herself) was young, it is likely that they are deeply bonded through their extensive time together.

cookies.name: Kouign-Amann Cookie
cookies.backstory: The Crème Knights is a noble institution, known not only for its rich tradition of ceremony and good deportment but also for the frilly dress-wearing Paladin: Kouign-Amann Cookie! Don't let her lovely appearance distract you; this Cookie is blessed by the Light itself and can defeat even experienced Paladins with just a swing of her sword. Kouign-Amann Cookie always stays true to her path and fights with honor, so it's no wonder the whole school looks up to her. There was a time when the fear of defeat and disappointing those around her troubled Kouign-Amann Cookie greatly, but instead of running away she faced those fears and conquered the insecurity within herself. For those of you fearless enough to duel this honorable Paladin, may you have a strong conviction and a brave heart! After all, nothing motivates Kouign-Amann Cookie more than battling opponents who have already battled themselves!
cookies.personality:
Kouign-Amann Cookie is a positive, strong, and confident Paladin who always believes in herself. She refuses to give up and will always work hard to bring victory to her fellow Crème Knights. Despite this, she sometimes doubts herself due to the fact that she is usually expected to never lose from the Knights, even when she struggles to. Even then, she still learns from her mistakes.

She also helps out her allies when they are in danger, showing that she cares for them.

cookies.name: Prune Juice Cookie
cookies.backstory: When you smell the fragrant yet subtle scent of plums across the door at the top of the endlessly spiraling staircase, you know Prune Juice Cookie is brewing his magic potions! This Cookie, made from the richest and most potent prune juice, is the best potion maker at the Parfaedia Institute. His potions are amazingly effective-just a single sip will have you feeling the dizzying effects! They say that his outstanding talent is not the sole reason he picked the efficient minimalistic art of potions over fancy, sweet dessert magic... But perhaps it's not so smart to snoop around the genius potion maker, as his charms and theatrics will persuade you to buy all of his potions! Even if you don't understand his true intentions, the effort he puts into his potion-making is evident in the ever-boiling cauldron and notebooks covered in potion stains.
cookies.personality:
Prune Juice Cookie is a polite yet ambitious Cookie with a deep interest in potions. Utilizing his mastery of potions, he sells and offers different kinds of concoctions to his peers in order to cure their ailments and needs for a fair price. His primary goal is to gain fame and prestige through his craft in order to become well-known and well-paid wherever he goes, thus earning himself the comfortable lifestyle he ultimately desires. His quiet, egocentric personality is one of his most prominent traits, as he does not consider any other Cookie to match his talents in potion-making. However, he is also ruthlessly competitive and willing to take risks to demonstrate his capabilities, as seen in the Triple Cone Cup competitions.

Prune Juice Cookie is quite perceptive and calculative, masking his true plans behind a friendly-looking facade to others. Despite his confidence in his own craft, he avoids underestimating other Cookies and their strengths, instead wondering aloud about their abilities in order to uncover any weaknesses. His own mannerisms and self-deprecation often lead others to underestimate his abilities, which allows him to surprise them with his potions due to their lowered expectations. This attitude stems from his past, when he had to come to terms with his inability to wield magic despite being enrolled in Parfaedia. He refuses to admit that this still affects him greatly, instead choosing to mask it by focusing on his potions, although he sometimes allows his bitterness towards "naturally-gifted" Cookies to show.

However, Prune Juice Cookie is not incapable of empathy, as he eventually befriends his rivals Capsaicin Cookie and Kouign-Amann Cookie throughout the Triple Cone Cup's trials. Although he did not initially plan on doing so, their friendship grows stronger throughout the trials, leading Prune Juice Cookie to value them as capable friends worth aiding and sacrificing his goals for. He learns from them how to have a sense of worth even without his potions, just as they learn from him how even seemingly-powerless Cookies can do great things.

cookies.name: Space Doughnut
cookies.backstory: Communication with this mysterious creature has proven to be a rather daunting task. We have yet to determine where they came from, where they are going, or even what they taste like... Does the Space Doughnut know? Another mystery! However, nothing stops us from befriending this adorable being even though we don't share the same language. And it seems like the Space Doughnut has already made a bunch of flat friends on their way here!
cookies.personality:
Space Doughnut speaks in an alien language exclusively, making it difficult for others to understand them. Despite this, they are very carefree and playful, and can easily bond with other Cookies like Stardust Cookie. They do not let any language barriers dissuade them from happily greeting strangers of any shape, size, or flavor, giving others the impression of a friendly creature.

Space Doughnut desires to live freely, away from the grasp of those who seek to use them for evil ends like Dr. Evilglaze. Even though they were once subjected to terrible situations, they do not seem to dwell on such memories, instead choosing to live life to the fullest.

cookies.name: Blueberry Pie Cookie
cookies.backstory: Somewhere within the abandoned and silent City of Wizards, a lone Cookie remains in the towering Archives. Blueberry Pie Cookie has kept watch over the Wizard Archives' dangerous tomes for countless years. Following her destiny, she continues to organize the endless shelves day by day. On a dark moonless night, when an oath to the Wizards had faded away with the light, Blueberry Pie Cookie's curiosity got the better of her: she opened and read one of the forbidden tomes... As days and nights of caretaking the Archives pass, she takes solace in a slender beam of moonlight that creeps in through a small window. Was forsaking an oath too much for a Cookie to handle?
cookies.personality:
Blueberry Pie Cookie is a reserved individual who takes her job very seriously, intimately knowing the location and contents of every tome in the Archives of the City of Wizards. She warns all visitors of the dangers of the Archives, but grants them access to any information that they might require.

Despite her diligent demeanor, she struggles with a sense of loneliness that she feels she cannot afford to indulge. The book that she holds reminds her constantly of a past transgression that she once committed, one that forever keeps her wary of the dangers of untested magic and broken promises.

cookies.name: Milky Way Cookie
cookies.backstory: Take a handful of star powder gathered from all over the Milky Way Galaxy, illuminate it with delicate moonlight—and voila! Meet Milky Way Cookie, the Slumbering Moon's faithful servant and the conductor of the Sugarcloud Express that will take you to your sweetest dreams and back. Don't be afraid and hop on: one sprinkle of Milky Way Cookie's star powder is enough for a colorful, vibrant dream-just like reality but better! Everything is possible in the World of Dreams, and accidents happen, too: every now and then, the train's floor disappears, and cars reshuffle randomly, leaving crowds of passengers in utter confusion. And right in the middle of the conductor's scheduled nap time! But professionalism never betrays, and there is no problem Milky Way Cookie can't sort out. Colorful hair neatly tied with a Star Jelly, conductor's hat on, and choo choo! The Sugarcloud Express will deliver you to your dreamy destination according to the schedule. Just make a wish upon a twinkling star...!
cookies.personality:
[Milky Way Cookie] looks cute but also has a tough side. You could call her a character with an unexpected charm. Personally I think her being the train conductor of the dream world and that her name is "Milky Way" is fun. You know, because she tends to behave in her own way... Milky Way... My way...

— Seo Yeokyeong, City of Wizards 🏙 Developer Commentary 💬

Milky Way Cookie is overall a lackadaisical and free-spirited Cookie. She is hardly ever truly professional during her work as a space-faring train conductor, often openly wishing for time off in front of travelers or blatantly disregarding standard protocol. Despite such, she holds genuine concern for her work and doesn't ever intend to sabotage anyone's travels. She simply assumes that things will turn out well no matter what—according to her, "everything is according to the Slumbering Moon's plan," so it's best to just trust her in whatever irresponsible deeds she performs. Simply put, this independent Cookie has her own unorthodox (and perhaps irresponsible) ideology on how to deal with anything that's thrown at her, and she cannot be swayed into doing things any other way. Her stubbornness can cause her to come off as brash, snarky, or uncaring, although she states that this is unintentional.

Milky Way Cookie is largely adaptable in spite of her lax nature and is willing to break rules for the greater good in times of need—something often necessary in a job as dynamic as a dream train operator. In fact, this conductor will do just about anything to make sure her travel routes end safely, so long as those methods don't include following any set rules. From making an unwitting passenger take control of her train alone to literally throwing invaders out of a moving vehicle, she does not mind taking drastic measures to ensure problems are solved.

cookies.name: Prophet Cookie
cookies.backstory: This wizened Cookie is often called "Fortune Cookie" for his ability to know what's coming before it happens. His Scroll of Prophecy guides his path, even if it isn't always right. Some say the source of his foresight is his mysterious purple Crystal Ball, but in reality, it is his majestic beard!

cookies.name: Pinecone Cookie
cookies.backstory: If you see a little Cookie running among the trees, it's probably Pinecone Cookie, the mighty keeper of the forest. Get outta the way! Busy, busy! The forest is so vast, yet there's only one Pinecone Cookie! There is so much to do: help the forest animals prepare for winter hibernation, straighten out the quarreling birds, find and scratch that itchy patch of bark for the oak tree, and much more! Each choco bark layer of Pinecone Cookie's imposing hat is filled with eagerness to protect their woodland home. That's right: the forest has been their home for as long as they can remember—which is why they prefer the company of trees and animals. Yes, the mighty forest keeper is hardly familiar with the ways of their fellow Cookies! But what does it matter when they know everything about the forest dwellers and can understand the language of the rustling leaves?!

cookies.name: Carol Cookie
cookies.backstory: This gentle Cookie believes that the song is stronger than the sword! She knows how to exert great power with beautiful poetry and melodies only. "No matter what happens, I will always have my songs. My Song of Love will always be around, my Song of Peace will cast darkness away, and my Song of Comfort will bring a smile to a tired face!"
cookies.personality: Carol Cookie is an equanimous and joyous songsmith with the firm belief that any hardship can be overcome through the passionate power of music, evident by many of her quotes dedicated to sharing her melodies with the Cookies. The possibility of defeat seems to do little to weaken her spirits, for her trust in love and the lyre is more powerful than any weapon.

cookies.name: Macaron Cookie
cookies.backstory: Did you think this Cookie was made with artificial food coloring? Guess again! She is made with 100% all-natural ingredients. Even her long, gorgeous eyelashes are completely organic. Cookies are drawn to her friendly smile and gentle voice. In fact, cute little Macaron Animals love to gather around her too. Once she starts playing on her macaron drum, the Macaron Animals start a tiny parade. At times, the parade can get out of hand, but Macaron Cookie still enjoys the company anyway. When she gets really excited, Macaron Cookie may demonstrate her most festive performance for you.
cookies.personality: Macaron Cookie is generally very cheerful and upbeat, possessing a great passion for her drumming. She loves parades and her Macaron animals, and always wants others to feel the same joy she does. In her section of the special story Crunchy Dreams, titled 'Again, Again, Again!', she gets anxious when drumming gets uneven and keeps trying to fix it to and starts drumming in her sleep, but once she wakes up and finds out her Macaron animals enjoy the sound of it, she decides they will march to an uneven beat that day, showing that while she wants to perfect her craft above all she wants others to feel happy in her parades.

cookies.name: Schwarzwälder
cookies.backstory: Red eyes, rough mane, sharp fangs! His name is Choco Werehound Brute, and his enormous hammer will make the Cookie Kingdom tremble! And if the sound of the distant thumping of this fearsome giant's heavy feet is not enough, his roar will make you faint! Choco Werehound Brute might be no more than Licorice Cookie's underling running itsy-bitsy errands, but his ambitions do not end here. Far from it! One day, he will become the strongest Cake Monster, and then, THEN...! The whole world will fear the name "Choco Werehound Brute!" And so, the big dreamer bids farewell to another gorgeous sunset under the pouring rain... The life of an upstart villain is rough and tough, but Choco Werehound Brute must be strong. He must not let anyone know of his proper aristocratic upbringing and his real name... Schwarzwälder.
cookies.personality:
VILLAIN ORIGIN STORY OF SCHWARZWALDER 🔨 - Cookie Run- Kingdom

Choco Werehound Brute acts in a very haughty, tough manner, acting particularly contrarily to those who oppose him or doubt his abilities. He doesn't take losses very gracefully and often goes through unfair measures to ensure his victory or spite those who have already defeated him, as do the rest of Licorice Cookie's gang. Choco Werehound Brute is initially presented as being an empty-headed ruffian—lending well to his title of "brute"—which is especially apparent in regards to his (now absent) rudimentary, incomplete way of speaking.

Despite his hardened presentation, Choco Werehound Brute possesses a sense of dignity and a desire for personal fulfillment underneath; for instance, he tells Licorice Cookie he "has [a] private life too" after being met with defeat and demanded to do too much. Choco Werehound Brute also has a refined side, which he tries to hide to the best of his ability. His description states that he comes from a "proper aristocratic upbringing," his brutish speech and tone often slip into something more gentle in his quotes, and he is said to enjoy a cup of tea alone in secret when his coworkers grate on him too much. Though he conceals almost all of his more sophisticated tastes, he is quite open about his interest in wearing lavish gowns.

In truth, Choco Werehound Brute is deeply embarrassed by his pampered past; he considers it a sign of weakness and therefore does everything in his power to stifle its coming to light. A large portion of Choco Werehound Brute's actions are done to make himself appear (or at least feel) more threatening and powerful to those around him. Always trying to prove himself as the best villain Earthbread will ever know, his dire efforts to show his strength are met with varying reactions and results—while foes like GingerBrave & Friends on first acquaintance often are intimidated by his brawn, those who know him and his vulnerable, desperate self better find it difficult to take his faux grandeur seriously.

This lighting makes him look tough, right?

Choco Werehound Brute's given name, Schwarzwälder, is a German word meaning "black forest," which references the German dessert known as Black Forest gateau (German: Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte, "Black Forest cherry torte"). It may be a remnant of the noble family and lifestyle of his past, as it is known that Choco Werehound Brute abandoned the name in order to curate his brutish persona. As a Cake Monster with a name based on a European dessert and a relation to high society, he is similar to Esterházy, a butler NPC shown during Timeless Kingdom; it is unknown if these two are related beyond sharing a species.

cookies.name: Candy Diver Cookie
cookies.backstory: Plop... Splash! Candy Diver Cookie pulls the lever on the wetsuit, and the two gumballs swirl a lap inside their helmet. Always out there, charting the unknown regions of the ocean floor, making sketches of fishes no one has ever seen, this deep-sea explorer might be tiny, but they leave an unforgettable first impression. Candy Diver Cookie has examined every underwater nook and cranny through the barnacled candy glass and probably witnessed whole coral forests grow and dissipate into pale dust that covers the soggy carcasses of sunken ships. All this curiosity, yet Candy Diver Cookie cannot find the answer to this one question: how does one end up all alone at the sea bottom? Whenever they try to catch onto the pieces of this mystery in the ocean of memory, they slip into the darker, deeper abyss.

cookies.name: Captain Caviar Cookie
cookies.backstory: "Don't ya dare fear the waves as long as you have a Captain in me!" Captain Caviar Cookie's bellowing voice, louder than the squall itself, can inspire the most desperate and ragtag bunch of sailors! This sea wolf laughs in the face of gale and waves-after all, the very caviar in his dough was a gift of a tide much rougher. It is easy to mistake the ever frowning, sharp-toothed Cookie for a vile pirate, but make no mistake: this Cookie before you is a respected Elder, one of the Republic's most famed heroes, savior of Choco Mud Town, and the bane of all villains and monsters plaguing the seas. Captain Caviar Cookie's trusty ship, the Salty Shark, and its seasoned crew have weathered many a storm only to find a way out to a safe haven. What song will they sing today, sailing towards a new glorious adventure?
cookies.personality:
Captain Caviar Cookie is a reserved Cookie that prefers to be a lone wolf among the Council. Believing that his navy is the primary power that keeps the oceans of the Republic safe, Captain Caviar Cookie keeps to his moral compass and beliefs, and isn't afraid to speak his mind to anyone who asks.

Captain Caviar Cookie has utmost confidence in his navy, claiming that the city would end up a "lawless cove" without their protection. While he runs a tight ship that keeps non-personnel Cookies off the navy's ships, he is typically friendly to those who would respect the navy in turn. He has a unique relationship with Oyster Cookie—while he has no love for the political games of intrigue that she plays, they are each other's most reliable allies in the Crème Republic.

cookies.name: Cream Unicorn Cookie
cookies.backstory: A desolate amusement park lies in darkness. Lights flicker on one by one. A merry-go-round begins to rotate slow and steady to a bygone song of the past. The park magically returns to life as a lone pony, embraced by the purest of rainbows, opens their eyes. The silky mane and creamy tail turn into elegant locks of hair. Decorations spring to life as fluttering sugar butterflies. Cream Unicorn Cookie flies around the park with the sugar butterflies in tow. After floating among the attractions, a graceful landing on top of the Ferris wheel concludes the course. A whisper escapes while gazing upon the entirety of the park. "In the end, all that shines are memories and stars." A flashback of the glee and joy of young Cookies running towards the merry-go-round plays before wistful eyes. If only it could turn for eternity... A dream of happiness and laughter has manifested as a unicorn. The dream never stops, regardless of night or day.

cookies.name: Financier Cookie
cookies.backstory: "I will only kneel before the Divines!" Financier Cookie has the qualities of an exemplary Paladin: she is most humble and sincere when offering a prayer yet radiates confidence and power, wielding her sword. No other cadet of the Paladin Academy could parallel Financier Cookie's outstanding abilities—perhaps, she was meant to be chosen for the honorable position of the Republic Consul's personal bodyguard. A true Paladin does not flinch at an order: the greatest deeds perpetuating the order's glory are done by those who are not afraid of challenges, and Financier Cookie marches towards her goal with scrupulous and cold determination. But appearances can be deceiving: seek the Republic's most unfortunate, and they will tell you the Paladin's heart is full of kindness and compassion.
cookies.personality:
Financier Cookie is a courageous Cookie—she is determined, bold, and duly represents the qualities one would expect of a paladin. Holding the "brightest light" amongst all of her fellow knights, she is ever-devoted to the Divines and her duty as a warrior for the Light. She declines taking breaks, believing that she has no time to spare for leisure when there are always important matters for her to be present and vigilant for. Her assigned job of protecting the Consul is one that she takes very seriously, never leaving him unguarded nor hesitating to defend him from any possible threat.

Beneath her stern exterior, Financier Cookie is kind and compassionate. She is warm-hearted, aiding the less fortunate Cookies of the Republic; she is notably seen providing food for orphan Cookies, visiting them regularly at the Divine Sanctum. She also remains humble even when held in higher regard, and feels that Madeleine Cookie's lack of the humility, in contrast, undercuts his position as Commander. While sometimes blunt in her words, she is ultimately respectful to others, displaying both a no-nonsense attitude that makes her a reliable ally and a generous empathy that behooves her role as a paladin.

Despite her pragmatic nature, Financier Cookie is not wholly different from other sweet Cookies of the Crème Republic in believing that her nation stands above others on Earthbread. For example, she could scarcely believe that the Vanilla Kingdom had teleportation technology—familiar as she was with the Republic's own technological progress—and she refers to the Cookie Kingdom as "part of the old world" with no known basis for such a remark. She was also open to challenging Crunchy Chip Cookie to a duel when he declared that Cookies couldn't become strong while on a sweet diet, confident that she could easily prove him wrong. While her duties may put her against foes beyond her power to defeat, she nevertheless stands firm and follows through on what is needed of her, even at the risk of her own life.

cookies.name: Crunchy Chip Cookie
cookies.backstory: One howl is all it takes to prep the Cream Wolves for battle, even in the middle of the night. Led by Crunchy Chip Cookie, this elite squad protects the frozen borders of the Dark Cacao Kingdom. The squad captain may be famous for his quick temper—which is not surprising given the sheer amount of the crunchiest choco chips in his dough—but rest assured: Crunchy Chip Cookie is loyal and reliable, just like his white-maned wolf companion. His oath to his king has kept him and his comrades persevering through piercing winds and snowstorms to ensure the kingdom's safety from the Licorice Sea. No other squadron stands a chance against these ferocious warriors that race through the mountains on the back of their wolves, defeating every monster they come across. Another serene morning in the Dark Cacao Kingdom; perhaps, we have to thank Captain Crunchy Chip Cookie for it!
cookies.personality:
Crunchy Chip Cookie is a proud warrior of the Dark Cacao Kingdom, often mentioning it to other Cookies. Additionally, he is proud of the work that he has done with his Cream Wolves; he has a close bond with them, often referring to the one with him at all times as his friend, or sometimes, his brother. His pride in their toughness makes him offended when the wolves are referred to as "puppy" or "doggo," determined to make the wolves out to be vicious and far more than just a dog.

Much of his dialogue is him yelling for whatever reason, indicating that he is proud of his place in the kingdom and confident in his abilities. But despite having a tough exterior, Crunchy Chip Cookie is shown to have a sweet tooth as seen in Chapters 1 and 2 of Cookie Odyssey; he avoids such food due to the highly disciplined customs of the Dark Cacao Kingdom. In Day 2 of Chapter 2, it was revealed that he has a dislike for sleeping in soft beds after confessing about having a nightmare the night before where Dark Cacao Cookie caught him eating sweets, and forced the Cream Wolves into disciplinary training, and even saying that "that thing defies everything the warriors of Dark Cacao stand for."

cookies.name: Wildberry Cookie
cookies.backstory: Filled to the brim with wild tropical berries, Wildberry Cookie's ardent loyalty to the Hollyberry Kingdom is unquestionable. And the brightly gleaming jewel embedded into his mighty gauntlet is proof! Young Wildberry Cookie once roamed the ramshackle alleys of the Hollyberry capital until an unexpected savior offered him a helping hand. Insidious whispers have been following this knight of few words ever since: they claim he is prone to solving problems with brute force, but these rumors cannot be farther from the truth. Wildberry Cookie has sworn to do whatever it takes to protect his kingdom and its royal dynasty! Even though sometimes what it takes is serving generous amounts of berry juice!
cookies.personality:
In contrast to other Hollyberrians and Hollyberry Cookie herself, Wildberry Cookie is an individual of few words, lacking the usual bursts of emotion seen in his fellow Hollyberrians, and will generally utter words only when spoken to. Even so, his responses are short and straight to the point. He is always seen with a deadpan face and expresses little-to-no emotion, as well as being a no-nonsense type. The only time he is seen to show strong emotion is during battle, in which he shouts loudly whenever he attacks.

Past his hard exterior, though, Wildberry Cookie is a trustworthy and loyal fighter who remains humble while being aware of his strengths. He has shown himself to be plenty capable in social situations and even appreciates wordplay—he simply prefers to keep what he says short.

cookies.name: Cherry Blossom Cookie
cookies.backstory: On a warm spring day, the first pink cherry blossoms were collected, then infused for a generous amount of time. Then this essence was used to create Cherry Blossom Cookie. Just by looking at her, you will feel splendid and warm inside, with a tingle on both your cheeks. On a perfect day, you can see her humming, trying to fly into the air with her umbrella open. She is most adorable when she offers you delicious sandwiches and tea. But watch out, once she starts to chat, you will lose track of time!

cookies.name: Caramel Arrow Cookie
cookies.backstory: At the very edge of the continent, atop the tall wall of the Black Citadel, stands a figure frowning into the dark. Night and day, all year round, Caramel Arrow Cookie, the First Watcher of the Dark Cacao Kingdom, will always protect the Cookies from the horrors of the Licorice Sea. A master of the Dark Cacao martial art tradition of the perfect balance and a wielder of the black and white twin blades, Caramel Arrow Cookie's loyalty to her king and subordinates remains unwavering even in exile. Some say the kingdom is but a shadow of its former glory, with values like trust becoming a commodity. But a vow is a vow. Standing there atop the tall wall, Caramel Arrow Cookie is staring sharply at the churning dark waters below. The First Watcher will protect the Dark Cacao Kingdom until the very last crumb.
cookies.personality:
Caramel Arrow Cookie is a determined, supremely loyal individual with a strong mental fortitude. As the First Watcher of the Dark Cacao Kingdom and the head of its most elite troops, she is as ardent towards her nation as one can be and refuses to back down when it and her comrades are threatened. However, her passion can often boil over and lead to actions fueled solely by her strong emotions and unmoving beliefs; Caramel Arrow Cookie is never one to hold her tongue—and her bow—when her dignity or that of those she cherishes is insulted.

The First Watcher is highly motivated, always being the one to stoke the flames of hope for crestfallen allies or even her own dejected self when things seem grim, as seen with her initial doubt and following self-reassurance upon being cast away from the Black Citadel and demoted in Snow on the Black Wall. Such a fervent yet dignified soul is almost akin to the formidable badlands of the Dark Cacao Kingdom, which Dark Cacao Cookie mentions himself shortly before casting Caramel Arrow Cookie away into the wilds.

Caramel Arrow Cookie's zeal is not attributed to only her homeland, though—her genuine compassion for others often shines from underneath her hardened exterior. This tenderness sometimes is even to a fault, though, as it is what led to her initial removal from the Black Citadel. Prior to her demotion, Caramel Arrow Cookie would put forth extraneous efforts to feed those starving and abandoned by the king in the Dark Cacao Kingdom with her own rations. The collusive Affogato Cookie took advantage of this kindness to twist her actions into a false case of rations stolen from the Citadel's own cupboards, and she is ostracized by order of King Dark Cacao Cookie. Even then, the First Watcher, exiled into the snowy dunes, would immediately go on to protect the vulnerable GingerBrave & Friends from a Snow Lion and guide their way to the Black Citadel. She is highly respectful towards those who deserve such as well, as she is seen going out of her way to honor her passed fellow Watchers at the Chocolate Altar of the Fallen while traveling with her new caravan.

It is said that Caramel Arrow Cookie is particularly accustomed to the wilderness. Upon her banishment, she immediately recollects her survival knowledge, remembering that she must craft twenty arrows per day to fend off all adversaries and that one mustn't fall to the soporific abilities of the Frozen Peak Prowler when facing one. Caramel Arrow Cookie also mentions that she has straw laced to her boots to help her retain traction in the snow, and a piece of loading screen trivia mentions that she is able to read the weather of the Dark Cacao mountains by heart.

cookies.name: Affogato Cookie
cookies.backstory: One piping hot cup of dark roasted coffee and a frozen scoop of the sweetest vanilla ice cream! Born of two desserts—so different yet so delicious—Affogato Cookie's flavor is unparalleled! Neither coffee nor ice cream, Affogato Cookie spent restless years without a place to belong until he came up with a simple solution: to create a land of his own once and for all! He appeared out of nowhere on a frigid night in the Dark Cacao Kingdom and has been busy earning the trust and favor of the locals with the help of his strange concoctions and mysterious chants. These are troubling times for the Dark Cacao Kingdom and the throne is empty... What sinister intention is Affogato Cookie hiding behind his snide smile?
cookies.personality:
Spending much of his life without "a place to belong," Affogato Cookie yearns for a place when he can live as he pleases. His plot to find this place involves earning the trust of Dark Cacao Cookie and his advisors, becoming closer to the Dark Cacao Kingdom's throne. He sees Caramel Arrow Cookie as both an obstacle to his goal and an undeserving recipient of Dark Cacao Cookie's attention.

Affogato Cookie is a cunning and manipulative schemer, driven by an insatiable desire for power and control. With a silver tongue he weaves deception effortlessly, persuading those around him to act in his favor while keeping his own hands clean. He thrives in the shadows, orchestrating downfall through whispered rumors, backhanded compliments, and veiled threats, all while maintaining an outward persona of loyalty and devotion.

He feigns concern for the kingdom’s well-being, presenting himself as the only one capable of guiding it through troubled times. He preys on doubt, exploiting both fear and ambition to rally supporters to his side. His influence extends beyond politics as his strange concoctions have garnered him a following of devoted disciples, all willing to carry out his bidding.

Beneath everything lies a ruthless opportunist who sees no ally as permanent. He is patient and strategic, waiting for the perfect moment to strike, yet adaptable enough to seize any unexpected advantage. His snide remarks and patronizing tone conceal a deep-seated arrogance. He truly believes himself superior to those around him.

Even when cornered, Affogato Cookie remains slippery like a snake that he is, twisting words and shifting blame with ease. His loyalty is to no one but himself, and he will abandon any cause or ally if it serves his interests.

cookies.name: Tea Knight Cookie
cookies.backstory: There was a time when dreadful dragons ruled the skies. Their fire ravaged entire kingdoms, and their claws crumbled countless Cookies. An order of knights in shiny silver armor, infused with courage and battle prowess, swore to put an end to this threat. Led by Tea Knight Cookie, the knights courageously opposed the gargantuan monsters through fire and jam and remained in history. But even the most fragrant tea loses its aroma—with time, the glorious tale of the knight became a legend, a mere echo of the past. Tea Knight Cookie, the fearless hero, was forgotten by those he strove to protect. Now sadness and regret shadow his scar-ridden face. Perhaps he wanted to be forgotten...? Yet... when he reminisces the battles he fought side by side with his comrades of old, a spark lights up in his eyes: the flame within him still burns bright!

cookies.name: Eclair Cookie
cookies.backstory: When you're looking around the museum, taking a look at the ancient relics that hold mysteries and stories untold, it feels as if the whole world has grown peaceful and silent. That's usually when the curator of this museum will approach you with a gentle and kind greeting. Eclair Cookie, at your service! With an entire dessert covered in premium fondant icing adorning his hat, he'll greet guests of the museum with elegance and grace, all while making sure there's no trace of dust to be found. But it must be said that he tends to go overboard with his explanations whenever a guest shows interest in his favorite topic: dragon-fighter Cookies! Which is precisely why he's mostly seen in his office, writing reports on these brave and heroic dragon-fighter Cookies. He may be sitting in front of his desk, but do not underestimate his scholarly heart—for his passion for history burns bright as any other adventurer exploring this world.
cookies.personality:
Eclair Cookie is an enthusiastic museum curator, whose primary passion is the collection of Relics from across Earthbread's history. He takes the maintenance of such a collection of antiques seriously, showing concern over even the slightest marring on any relic while also disdaining the idea of being treated like a simple "appraiser." To him, all objects of historical value possess tremendous worth, and deserve to be displayed to other Cookies.

As a model scholarly historian, and a history professor at the Parfaedia Institute, Eclair Cookie researches and documents a wide coverage Earthbread history, especially dragon fighter Cookies such as Tea Knight Cookie and the Tea Leaf Order. He remains especially excited about documenting new historical happenings as well, such as the events of An Oath Lit by Beacons.

cookies.name: Cocoa Cookie
cookies.backstory: Even if her dough is 80% cocoa, she's always sipping hot cocoa, even during the summer time. Her marshmallow hat is so deliciously sweet, she needs to resist the temptation of taking a chunk out of it and dipping it into her cup. Her plump smooth cheeks just add to her charm! When she indulges in a freshly prepared cup of cocoa, all her worries melt away.
cookies.personality:
Listening to Mint Choco Cookie's special piece for her

Cocoa Cookie is a very kind, sweet person who really cares about her fellow Cookies. She tries her best to help other people whenever possible, even if she has something else to do and helping could interrupt that. She very commonly invites other Cookies to her house, offers them hot cocoa and shares stories with them by the fireplace.

Her most notable trait by far is her unwavering love for drinking hot cocoa. Most, if not all, of her quotes involve cocoa or metaphors related to cocoa. Whenever she feels tired, upset, or lonely, she serves herself a nice cup of hot cocoa, and it’s what she recommends to the player and other Cookies to do, as she thinks it can solve any problem- such is her belief, that she will even offer to share a cup of cocoa to avoid fighting. One of her loading screen quotes also has her threaten her foes in case they stop her from having her cocoa.

cookies.name: Cotton Cookie
cookies.backstory: The soft and warm cotton fluff in Cotton Cookie's dough granted her a heart so warm not even a raging blizzard could scare her off. The way she handles her flock of cute wooly sheep ever so gently with her tiny lantern in hand can make anyone feel at peace! Having a lantern in Cotton Cookie's land of constant snowfall is very important: not only stray sheep but also Cookies lost among the dreary white hills depend on it. Cotton Cookie can often be seen restlessly looking at the sky on snowy days—as though expecting to find something amidst the drifting snowflakes. Sometimes, she mentions a Cookie dear to her: her serene, calm face lightens up, making the listener wonder... what happened? Will we ever learn that someone out there is keeping a piece of these snowy plains in their heart? And that a warm yellow light of the tiny lantern will always shine for that special someone. Always.

cookies.name: Pumpkin Pie Cookie
cookies.backstory: It's Halloween, a time of spooky fun for all ghosts and Cookies. And amidst the Jack-o'-lanterns adorning the streets, stands Pumpkin Pie Cookie watching others dressed up in their costumes. Perhaps it's because she was made of a pumpkin that grew in the shade of an abandoned house, untouched by the sun, but she seems... distant, even though she has a smile on her face. One might try to escape this Cookie's uncanny presence, but there is something eerily captivating in the way she slowly bats her eyelashes... Pumpkin Pie Cookie's favorite things on Earthbread are her fluffy and poofy dress that resembles a pumpkin and the old, tattered doll she always carries around. This Cookie will hold your hand and drag you to play with her whenever there's an exciting festival. Surprisingly, no one has ever said no. You can only wonder if it's because of Pumpkin Pie Cookie's doll that looks almost alive or the giant wavering shadow behind her...

cookies.name: Twizzly Gummy Cookie
cookies.backstory: Would you look at that? Gummy wires twisted here and there, sparks flying everywhere! Maybe that's why Twizzly Gummy Cookie's temperament is like chaos itself! She insists that if she doesn't wreak havoc even for one day, her hair will start crackling electricity! *BZZZZT* With her ticking time bomb of a Electrojelly Gun, she will bulldoze a planet and pulverize the planet right next to it! No wonder they call her the Cosmic Criminal—look at her cause absolute mayhem everywhere she lands! To her, battles are just another game that gives her electrifying thrills. Looks like she's done messing with her universe and ready to jump to another dimension! Just what could she be plotting next? Her evil cackling and rampaging sparks can't be good news... Well, good luck to those who come in her way... because it's gonna hurt!
cookies.personality: Twizzly Gummy Cookie presents herself as being quite chaotic due to the way she laughs maniacally and makes various shooting and zapping sound effects. Greedy and wicked, she is often seen in the T.B.D.'s most wanted posters because of her time-disruption crimes. She cares for nothing other than herself, her group of fellow outlaws, and chaos.

cookies.name: Mala Sauce Cookie
cookies.backstory: The blistering heat of the Dragon's Valley seems inhospitable to all forms of life. That is... until you get to know the spicy Cookies of the Mala Tribe. The entire tribe is unyieldingly spicy, but none come close to Mala Sauce Cookie with her mind-numbing, fiery taste! Her strength knows no bounds: a simple tap on a boulder shatter it to pieces, a full swing of her Morning Star Anise triggers a massive whirlwind. Due to her fierce determination to protect the tribe, she was the only cookie who succeeded in the dreaded Trial of the Dragon. It's no wonder that she is destined to be the future leader! Despite the twists and turns with her first adventure outside of the village, if she can captivate the spicy denizens of the Mala Tribe, the outside world doesn't stand a chance!
cookies.personality: Mala Sauce Cookie is a fierce Cookie who loves a good fight, much like the rest of her tribe. Despite her appearance, however, she is a kind, jovial, and welcoming of Cookies that gets to know her. She is determinedly loyal to her tribe, doing her best to live up to the expectations put upon her as its chieftain.

cookies.name: Moon Rabbit Cookie
cookies.backstory: Fresh rice harvested from the happy soils of the Cookie World was used for baking the happy Moon Rabbit Cookie. This Cookie's chubby cheeks are always filled with sweet rice cakes. And while some may think it's cute, her craving for more rice cakes might be one of the strongest forces of the Universe. That craving can even become so strong that she might turn into a giant Rice Cake Bunny, and—oh boy!—you'd better keep your distance because she is going to wreak SWEET HAVOC. A group of particularly brave Cookies once tried to keep the giant Rice Cake Bunny in check by grabbing each other's hands and building a circle around her. Ever since, the Cookies have kept a tradition of holding hands and going around in circles under the full moon.

cookies.name: Raspberry Cookie
cookies.backstory: Amidst the generous raspberry fields illuminated by the Hollyberry Kingdom's hot sun, proudly stands the grand Chateau Raspberry. In this place of history and culture, Raspberry Cookie was born and raised. Just like her great ancestors, she began fencing even before she learned the intricacies of aristocratic etiquette and rhetoric. Raspberry Cookie has been molded to become the heir and defender of the noble House Raspberry, sworn to protect its legacy. With her sword in hand, elegantly glazed hair fluttering in the summer breeze, and the proud House Raspberry banners behind her back, Raspberry Cookie is about to claim another victory from the clasp of fate.
cookies.personality: Raspberry Cookie is an honorable and fair (albeit pompous) fencer of House Raspberry. As the heiress of the House, she takes dueling and her family's dignity seriously; this is shown when, after hearing Princess Cookie's negative opinion on seeing Cookies fighting each other, she challenges the former to a duel. However, she quickly buries the hatchet and helps GingerBrave and friends in stopping Pitaya Dragon Cookie from annihilating the Hollyberry Kingdom.

cookies.name: Parfait Cookie
cookies.backstory: In a time when there's never a day without a new hot celebrity idol, this singer-songwriter Cookie desperately tries to stick out with sweet toppings in vivid colors! Parfait Cookie's distinct style involves layers of chocolate and candy, topped with dripping syrup. Despite still being a rookie, this Cookie already has dozens of self-written songs. Parfait Cookie's melodies may be just as creative and unique as her colorful mixture of toppings, but her lyrics are always as pure and honest as vanilla ice cream. "It doesn't matter if the audition goes bad, if no one recognizes me, or even if my toppings melt in the summer rain! I keep playing my guitar and sing about the truth in my heart."

cookies.name: Squid Ink Cookie
cookies.backstory: Squid Ink Cookie came out of the oven not even a little bit crispy. Maybe that's because of all the viscous ink inside! The Cookie was found floating along the seashore, all weak and confused. There is a theory that this Cookie is the legendary treasure-eating sea monster that attacked treasure ships, hungry for more gold. But Squid Ink Cookie can't remember anything of that and spends all the time oozing blackish inky tears.

cookies.name: Sorbet Shark Cookie
cookies.backstory: Once upon a time, there was a shark that lived in the deep blue sea. This curious swimmer often popped up to the surface to watch the pirates party on their ships. The shark yearned to join the Cookies for these parties, but they always ran away. Saddened, the shark disappeared into the sea for ages. Until suddenly... Sorbet Shark Cookie burst forth from the depths! This Cookie is, frankly, not the fastest runner, can only make bubbly noises instead of words, and gets soggy in the water just like everyone else. But even so, Sorbet Shark Cookie is always wearing a bright smile! After all, the world above the sea is vast and there's so many things to see!
cookies.personality:
Sorbet Shark Cookie watching a Durianeer party

Back when they were a simple shark, Sorbet Shark Cookie admired life above the sea, and would often watch pirates on their ships, partying together and being merry. They had dreamt of befriending and joining the pirates on their endeavors, but because of their appearance, they would scare away anyone they approached. This made them quite the lonely individual, always being misunderstood due to their species. On top of becoming a pirate, they wished to become a Cookie and roam the land without anyone running from them in fear.

After becoming a Cookie and gaining their land legs from Black Pearl Cookie, Sorbet Shark Cookie blossomed into an enthusiastic, cheery individual—one happy to help the pirates in performing their tasks and duties, whether or not they were aware of the pirates' true intentions. That being said, they appear somewhat naïve and oblivious, as they really only work with pirates due to the adventuring required.

Sorbet Shark Cookie is not a malicious individual by heart, and simply desires the company of others. They willingly let Princess Cookie go from Stink-Eye Tortuca's imprisonment—even if it would put their own place in the pirate crew at risk—showing their sense of morals and judge of character. Sorbet Shark Cookie is also quite mischievous, however, and isn't a stranger to trouble as they ran away from Knight Cookie and his attempts to capture them.

cookies.name: Lilac Cookie
cookies.backstory: Lilac petals are known as one of the core ingredients of the love potion. Finely sliced fragments of these petals were sprinkled into the dough and baked under the scorching desert sun. Lilac Cookie treads behind the veil of darkness only to appear with a gust of petals, mere moments before his unsuspecting foes take their final breath. Luring his targets with an irresistible fragrance, Lilac Cookie swiftly sends them to their end with his razor-sharp chakrams, leaving neither footprints nor a sound. The only remnants of his presence are but a few purple petals on the ground... and the lingering, yet soothing scent of lilac in the air.
cookies.personality:
An assassin by trade, Lilac Cookie is known for his enigmatic demeanor and sharp skills. He is an aloof and guarded Cookie who rarely talks, preferring to work in secrecy. In the Tropical Soda Islands Story, he devises a plan to retrieve the Naga's Heart from Stink-Eye Tortuca using a sleeping powder he created himself. Throughout the episode, he is consistently shown to be calculating and shrewd, able to think many steps ahead of Princess Cookie.

At times, Lilac Cookie can be quite ruthless in his decision-making. Had Princess Cookie fallen for the sleeping powder, he would not have helped her escape the ship nor had he liberated the captured villagers at her insistence. He prioritizes efficiency and stealth in enacting his plans, often laying aside irrelevant junctures in pursuit of his immediate goal. He also has a curt way of speaking and prefers that others get straight to the point. Nevertheless, he is easy to sway and will help others out if he has the means to do so. At the end of his journey with Princess Cookie and Knight Cookie, he graciously thanks them for helping him and looks forward to meeting them again some day. Princess Cookie remarks that, like Knight Cookie, Lilac Cookie is very reliable.

Lilac Cookie is also shown to be very loyal to Yogurt Cream Cookie, accompanying him on his adventures and working constantly to keep him out of danger.

cookies.name: Mango Cookie
cookies.backstory: The sun glistens above the serene palm trees of the Tropical Soda Archipelago. Once you arrive, Mango Cookie will give you a cheerful, hearty welcome making you feel right at home! With ripe mangoes mixed straight into the dough, Mango Cookie is pure-spirited and tenderhearted. Whether it's spending time along the emerald coasts or exploring the islands with his canoe, Mango Cookie makes sure to enjoy life to the fullest. When the sun reaches its peak, sometimes he'll hang up his hammock underneath the shade of the palm trees and take a relaxing nap. When Cookies visit the archipelago, Mango Cookie can't help becoming a hyper chatterbox. Mangoes will ripen by the time he runs out of stories to tell!
cookies.personality: Mango Cookie loves to greet his fellow Cookies with a warm welcome. He has a warm heart and loves to tell stories chronicling his sea-faring adventures. However, that doesn't stop him from being a chatterbox, continuing to tell stories until fruits grow fully ripe.

cookies.name: Red Velvet Cookie
cookies.backstory: "OBEY ME, MY BEASTS!" Red Velvet Cookie's order, like a thunderbolt, rolls over the battlefield. "FALL IN!" And the horde of snarling Cake Monsters obediently assumes a dreadful battle formation. The crimson general personally leads his legion into battle, sowing fear with his clenched cake fist and his black eye gleaming with the dark fire of battle fervor. The battle-hardened warrior will see his mission to its end with precision and relentlessness. "UNLEASH CHAOS, MY BEASTS!" he roars as the battle begins. Adding silently: "But please, come back alive..."
cookies.personality:
Red Velvet Cookie with various Cake Hounds

Unlike the other members of Dark Enchantress Cookie's group, Red Velvet Cookie treats his Cake Monster comrades empathetically. He trains them diligently, encourages them to perform well, and takes care of their health. He even first regards Pastry Cookie as a potential recruit before their battle, and works tirelessly to produce more of them. In fact, Red Velvet Cookie openly loves Cake Monsters, calling them "the cutest" and treating them more like cherished pets and family members rather than underlings, as seen with individuals like Chiffon and Cakeberus.

He wholeheartedly rejects the idea that Cake Monsters must be destroyed while only Cookies are allowed to live freely, seeing both races as equally worthy of life and fighting to make a place for Cake Monsters in the world. He was a firm supporter of Dark Enchantress Cookie's philosophy, believing that Earthbread needed to be rebuilt anew - in his eyes, it would bring forth the Cookie/Cake Monster equality he fought for. But after witnessing the extreme measures Dark Enchantress Cookie took, he was quick to leave the Cookies of Darkness, refusing to fight for a Cookie willing to sacrifice millions of Desserts and become a Witch for her goal.

cookies.name: Pastry Cookie
cookies.backstory: In the name of the Dough, the Oven, and the Witches, I shall fulfill my sacred duty!" Pastry Cookie left her name and her past behind on the day of her Sacred Brining when she was rebaked as a devoted sister of the St. Pastry Order. "... like a rolling pin flattening the many layers of pastry dough into uniformity, hardships and suffering produce the endurance to conquer the temptations of our crumbly bodies and souls." Now, looking from under the golden phyllo veil, these eyes see nothing else but a turbulent world to be rebuilt in the Order's image. Wielding the Fork of Judgment, her consecrated crossbow, Pastry Cookie has set on her next mission to investigate a tainted shrine. And you would be wise not to stand in her way: the cruel cold metal hungers to deliver judgment.
cookies.personality:
Pastry Cookie is a pious, humble member of the St. Pastry Order, routinely praying every morning and diligently honing both her weapon and her mind. She zealously believes in the Order's teachings and devoutly follows its commands without question, taking it upon herself to "purge the unclean" and deliver final judgment to beings such as Cake Monsters. Pastry Cookie also has a habit of reciting the Order's readings from memory to reaffirm her beliefs when necessary.

Despite this, Pastry Cookie is not entirely devoid of her own thoughts and opinions. When confronting Red Velvet Cookie in the Tower of Sweet Chaos story, she declares to "purge him and his foul creations" in the name of the St. Pastry Order, only to hesitate before delivering the final blow. She is stopped by the sight of Red Velvet Cookie comforting a pet Cake Hound that appears distressed over his injuries and shows a trace of sympathy for them both. This doubt remains with Pastry Cookie as she returns to the St. Pastry Order, leaving her questioning both the divinity of the Witches and the impurity of the Cake Monsters.

cookies.name: Fig Cookie
cookies.backstory: If you ever go for a forest picnic on a bright sunny day when the fragrant wind caresses your cheeks, the curious Fig Cookie may shyly appear from behind the leaves! This Cookie is known to have dwelled in verdant forests of light and honey for a long, long time. Year after year, the forest awakens at the cheerful sound of Fig Cookie's Jelly Horn, and the brightest of flowers become more colorful and lively than ever. When Fig Cookie shares tales as old as the forest itself, animal friends gather around and listen intently. Prancing about to and fro, the Cookie sometimes ventures to the very edge of the forest to play and run with other Cookies.

cookies.name: Black Raisin Cookie
cookies.backstory: Harsh wind, crooked trees, streets ravaged by the war... Who is it there, hiding among the shadows? Black Raisin Cookie, the sole protector of the unfortunate remnants of a once-great Kingdom. Made of shriveled, wrinkly raisins, this Cookie has learned the value of survival no matter what. Even having lost one arm to the dangers of this rough barren, this Cookie keeps hunting for scarce food to feed those who put their trust in her. Despite all the hardships, Black Raisin Cookie doesn't lose the warmth of a Cookie heart: everyone deserves help, even a sorry one-legged crow. A new day is breaking, and another challenge is here. But Black Raisin Cookie will be there for the villagers, watching over them from the dark.
cookies.personality:
Black Raisin Cookie initially presents herself as distrustful and hostile, threatening away any by-passer she views as an intruder. She is also skeptic and easy to distrust others, often jumping to the conclusion that said person is a threat to the safety of her village. This is due to the cruel and unjust area she lives in, where she has to fight for her own survival and the survival of her peers.

Having endured life in a harsh environment, gathered with the responsibilities to keep on a lookout for her villagers, Black Raisin Cookie has adapted to become protective of her peers to the point of over-protective. Towards her villagers, she displays herself as loyal and reliable, willing to endure the hardest of obstacles to ensure the safety of her village. She is also noted to be selfless, not only prioritizing her villagers, but also other living creatures around her, such as giving whatever remaining food stock she has in storage. Once getting to know her better, she has revealed herself to be a gentle and caring individual, and is forgiving, as she has reconciled with Pure Vanilla Cookie after their heated argument that caused the two to separate ways.

cookies.name: Latte Cookie
cookies.backstory: Coffee or milk... that is the question. Why not both? Latte Cookie's dough was formed with coffee most bitter and acrid, balanced with the creamiest and smoothest blend of milk. With her etched staff in hand, she gracefully draws beautifully patterned Latte Glyphs in the air while daydreaming. But watch out! By chance, one of these Glyphs could be a powerful sigil for a grand spell! During her years as a student, she spearheaded research on the development of Coffee Magic with a rather eccentric aficionado of coffee. Thanks to her efforts, Latte Cookie was granted a professorship at the Parfaedia Magic Institute. You'd think that a professor would be more punctual, especially with their own lectures. But not Latte Cookie! She's more invested in savoring a warm latte before class. Though far from achieving the Professor of the Year Reward, she knows a thing or two about inspiring her students. With her genuine compliments and encouraging smile, Latte Cookie is already the favorite professor of many.
cookies.personality: Latte Cookie is a well-regarded professor of the Parfaedia Institute, frequently inspiring her students to improve their work by giving genuine compliments and encouraging smiles. She often arrives to work tardy, distracted either by the aroma of a good latte or her own flawed sense of direction. However, she also knows how to be serious when dangerous situations arise, wielding her Latte Magic to great effect.

cookies.name: Cream Puff Cookie
cookies.backstory: The sweet Cream Puff Cookie makes you feel delighted just by looking at her. Made of soft and delicate cream puff, this Cookie is as fragile as can be. Something always makes you worry about Cream Puff Cookie, but it's certain that great power sleeps within her. Once she used to study magic on her own, but now she is a graduate of a prestigious Magic Academy! Will Cream Puff Cookie be able to become a famous wizard? Let's find out!
cookies.personality: Cream Puff Cookie is a warmhearted and innocent young Cookie with great potential to become a wizard, but suffers from clumsiness and low self-esteem. Despite that, she never gives up, even within the slightest mistake. She constantly seeks to improve and wishes to someday help other Cookies with her magic. She believes that mistakes are just a stepping stone for success (which is true!).

cookies.name: Kumiho Cookie
cookies.backstory: A fox-shaped marshmallow wished to become a Cookie so much that it mastered a spell to shapeshift into a Cookie by surviving only on flour and butter for 999 days. As a result, she can now disguise herself as a seductive and attractive Cookie. Anyone who catches even a glimpse of her will instantly fall in love. Perhaps she's dazzling them with her nine tails.
cookies.personality:
Kumiho Cookie is a highly charming Cookie who knowingly feigns a coy and demure front. She often acts unassuming and harmless while seamlessly flattering others, sweet-talking her peers with names like "sweetheart", "honey", and "cutie pie", to ensure that she is seen as both an overall non-threat and something lovable. This facade overlaps with her seductress tendencies, of which she is notably proud and confident—the vixen spends much of her dialogue mentioning how others can't seem to resist her allure. Kumiho Cookie even goes so far as to inject certain carnal implications to her words, imploring others to "come closer", "count her tails", and "be gentle with her". Though the results of her seduction are mostly left unseen in Kingdom, Kumiho Cookie's social confidence seems warranted as she is greatly adept at beguiling Bear Jellies in OvenBreak. The effect is likely compounded further by the fact that she is canonically considered to be attractive and can render others love-struck with a simple glance based on her in-game description.

Kumiho Cookie with a similarly deceptive figure

As for the motivation behind such behavior, it remains unclear based solely on canon materials (particularly because she is not often addressed much at all in depth in the Cookie Run series). However, Kumiho Cookie's deception seems to be implied to be something malicious and exploitative when her kumiho (구미호) origins are considered; as stated in the Character Inspiration section, kumiho are notorious for using their wiles and the illusion of a beautiful woman's form to dine on the innards of unwitting, lustful men. It should be mentioned that she also subsequently eats the Bear Jellies she seduces in OvenBreak. Even besides these possible ends to her acts, though, Kumiho Cookie appears to simply enjoy the attention garnered from her ploys.

Amongst her wanton conduct, Kumiho Cookie makes certain to infuse her speech with certain notes of mystery to, naturally, lure in curious listeners, but also to mask her "true" identity. It is said that Kumiho Cookie's true form is that of a wintry marshmallow fox—this vixen underwent 999 days of survival on only butter and flour to master a spiritual spell which allows her to transform into a gorgeous Cookie at will. It's quite unclear why the fox wished so strongly to be a Cookie; perhaps she had wicked intentions, but, at the same time, she may have only wanted to live among Cookies. Ironically, Kumiho Cookie seems spellbound with the Cookies in general, as even now she wishes she could be "a real Cookie" and refers to the species as "fascinating". Despite her strong will and confident air, she seems to harbor some insecurity about her not being a "true" Cookie, as she refers to her fox form as a "secret" and reacts strongly when the player discovers the form in her Shroomie Shenanigans transformation. Even then, it seems Kumiho Cookie isn't above using her unique abilities and features like her spirit flames, somersaults, and many tails to beguile an unsuspecting passerby—so long as the situation doesn't cut too close to the bone of her identity.

cookies.name: Werewolf Cookie
cookies.backstory: Together with a great amount of pepper, a wolf hair had fallen into the cookie dough by accident. Now, whenever Werewolf Cookie feels scared or threatened, his wolf instinct kicks in to transform him into a feral beast. A long time ago, when a friend was in great peril, Werewolf Cookie managed to save them by transforming, at a cost. With his true nature revealed to the whole town, he was cast away out of fear and has been living alone in the forests since. With so much pain inside, this Cookie tastes bitter and salty (of tears). Don't ask about his scar or try to get close, as he will only push you away...
cookies.personality:
Werewolf Cookie is a soul full of remorse and wariness, reserving himself to solitude and pushing others away from himself in concern for their safety—this is due to his ability to transform into a beastly wolf when threatened or angry, which he has trouble controlling. It can be assumed that such a fixation on protecting others from himself stems from an event in his past in which he was cast out of his village out of fear of his beast form. Since then, he has been consumed by guilt and has been rendered bitter and tearful. It's said that the only thing that soothes his soul is spending time in the woods, howling alone.

Werewolf Cookie with friends

Werewolf Cookie struggles with self-fulfillment and self-care as he dedicates virtually all of his energy into keeping himself from others and controlling the beast within him. Despite his isolation, he admits that he feels lonely and longs for a time when his scars—both physical and metaphorical—will heal. His quiet nature also makes him the perfect target for being dragged into social events by more bombastic personalities like Cherry Blossom Cookie and Carrot Cookie; during such, he can be seen constantly attempting to slip away again, though he eventually comes to accept his position and perhaps even enjoys his time with others. It can be said that many of his peers recognize his true intentions as being not those of a monster but of simply a wary and kind individual, as he is called "a good wolfie" by Cherry Blossom Cookie and "noble Mister Wolf" by Custard Cookie III.

More recently, Werewolf Cookie has found an outlet for his emotions in singing. He moonlights as a blues singer under the moniker WERETOFLOW, singing his genuine songs on the stage of the Summer Soda Rock Festa.

cookies.name: Vampire Cookie
cookies.backstory: The Witch, busy baking several Cookies at once, had forgotten to use her favorite high-quality grapes. Instead, she stored them in oak barrels and let age for a long, long time. And with that special grape juice, she made Vampire Cookie. Naturally, it was difficult for Vampire Cookie to wake up at first—after all, his dough contained more than 10% of strong grape juice! Unlike the other Cookies, Vampire Cookie prefers to do nothing but enjoy life. He wasn't even bothered by the heat of the oven and only escaped because his sister Alchemist Cookie dragged him outside. With his pale face and smug posture, he likes to relax with a glass of grape juice and ponder the meaning of life.
cookies.personality: Vampire Cookie is an overall laid-back, apathetic Cookie who likes to relax and just enjoy life. However, he can also be a chill and friendly Cookie to be with. He could possibly always be tired or bored, as one of his victory and defeat dialogues contains him yawning, and his exclusive loading screen displays the text: "Always watch your step: Vampire Cookie might be taking a nap on the ground!"

cookies.name: Tiger Lily Cookie
cookies.backstory: It is not known how Tiger Lily Cookie ended up in the jungle all by herself. Under the constant threat of encroaching enemies, her senses grew sharp. In contrast to her rough outward appearance, she is soft and delicate on the inside. Her only family is her trusty Butter Tiger, whom she cherishes more than anything in the world. Her great skill with the spear and excellent jumping abilities make her one tough Cookie to beat.
cookies.personality:
Tiger Lily Cookie is akin to a cautious yet capable tigress both in personality and behavior: growling and purring, she spends much of her time skulking about in the jungle's shadows. Such a persona was formed through her turbulent childhood: born into the Hollyberry Kingdom's royal family, Tiger Lily Cookie was kidnapped by dragons ransacking the land as a newborn during Hollyberry Cookie's absence. Though a friendly Butter Tiger would adopt her after she was cast into the jungle, Tiger Lily Cookie would from there struggle with rebuilding her identity. Inadvertently, she would take after her mother, a Cookie once born into a jungle warrior group, and rewrite herself as a fierce spearfighter with a keen lay of the land and connection with its fauna.

Tiger Lily Cookie and Jungleberry Cookie, whom she takes after greatly

As a result of her separation from society, Tiger Lily Cookie has difficulty speaking in standard Cookie language, talking slowly and relying on simple terms while interjecting with animal sounds more familiar to her. Though she is capable of communication, she is still a quiet, independent individual, often preferring not to interact with others at all. Even with her wild upbringing, Tiger Lily Cookie often avoids violence and is wary of strangers. She shows sympathy through her actions, such as with volunteering to fend off monsters attacking Hollyberry Cookie's party in Garden of Sweet Delights and sharing berries with those friendly towards her in Battlefield of Passion. She derives enjoyment from simple pleasures like running through the jungle on a full stomach and sweeping with a broom, though happiness is rarely displayed by a character so defined by isolation and a struggle to survive.

Despite her fears, Tiger Lily Cookie is often seen lurking about and observing other Cookies from the Kingdom from which she was estranged, curious but cautious of its citizens. This and her statements of wishing other Cookies were more like her convey a desire to belong—though she loves Butter Tiger and thrives in her rural lifestyle, she is cognizant of the fact that it is not where she is intended to be. Onlookers during her uncommon appearances amongst other Cookies have remarked on her similarity to her lost family—especially her mother—though neither party has yet realized Tiger Lily Cookie's true identity; she remains jungle-bound and burdened with an uncertain sense of self.

cookies.name: Strawberry Crepe Cookie
cookies.backstory: Sweet strawberry cream, crispy waffles, and chubby fresh strawberries—is there a cuter combination? Meet Strawberry Crepe Cookie with an unyielding sparkle of curiosity in their eyes. And this curiosity is a force to be reckoned with: Strawberry Crepe Cookie will stop at nothing to find an answer to every question! Having grown up with Wafflebots, this Cookie preferred tinkering with robotic parts to playing with toys. This little genius's cute waffle headset is a tiny engineering marvel on its own. But don't touch it! Or you risk witnessing a change from the cute Strawberry Crepe Cookie to the furious one.
cookies.personality:
Despite this Cookie's cute appearance, Strawberry Crepe Cookie has a very demanding, self-centered personality, often commanding those around them to personally entertain them to stave off boredom. This Cookie also tends to act quite selfishly; after awakening from cryostasis after the Dark Flour War, they meet Dark Enchantress Cookie and join her cause because of her promise to allow them do whatever they please.
